am.L: በስሜ በሐሰት ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና፤ እኔ አልላክኋቸውም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: በስሜ የሐሰት ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና። እኔ አልላክኋቸውም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ስሜን እየጠሩ ውሸት ይነግሯችኋል። እኔ አልላክኋቸውም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: क्योंकि वे मेरे नाम से तुमसे झूठी भविष्यवाणी करते हैं; मैंने उन्हें नहीं भेजा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: क्योंकि वे मेरे नाम से तुमसे झूठी भविष्यवाणी कर रहे हैं। मैंने उन्हें नहीं भेजा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: वे मेरा नाम लेकर तुमसे झूठ बोल रहे हैं। मैंने उन्हें नहीं भेजा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Ведь ложно они пророчествуют вам {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не посылал их, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Они пророчествуют вам ложь {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем. Я не посылал их, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Они прикрываются {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем и говорят вам ложь. Я не посылал их, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 彼らは、わたしの名によって偽りをあなたがたに預言しているからだ。わたしは彼らを遣わしていない――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。
ja.B: 彼らは、わたしの名によって、あなたがたに偽りを預言しているのだ。わたしは彼らを遣わしていない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: 彼らは、わたしの名を使って、あなたたちにうそを語っている。わたしは、彼らを遣わしてはいない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: Бо неправдиво вони пророкують вам {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не посилав їх, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Бо вони пророкують вам неправду {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям. Я не посилав їх, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Вони прикриваються {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям, щоб говорити вам брехню. Я не посилав їх, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: they prophesy falsely in my name; I did not send them
decisions.reason: Jeremiah brings the same charge against the prophets of peace in Jerusalem (14:14-15; 23:21, 25) and against those who told the kings not to serve Babylon (27:15). A true prophet is one whom God sends (1:7).

decisions.choice: in my name: claiming my authority
decisions.reason: To prophesy in someone's name is to speak as his messenger, with his authority. These prophets used the LORD's name for words he had not given them.

decisions.choice: declares the LORD (Literal, Balanced); says the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula in Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: — слово ГОСПОДА (L); говорит ГОСПОДЬ (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula neʾum YHWH keeps the noun at Literal, set off with dashes, and is "говорит ГОСПОДЬ" at Balanced and Readable, as through this block.

decisions.choice: besheqer "偽り" (L, B), "うそ" (R) as 28:15; bishmi "わたしの名によって" (L, B), "わたしの名を使って" (R) (m2); ne'um YHWH by the JER formula.
decisions.reason: JER-1 formulas.

source.text: כִּֽי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֠י לְפִ֞י מְלֹ֧את לְבָבֶ֛ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה אֶפְקֹ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרִ֣י הַטּ֔וֹב לְהָשִׁ֣יב אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: For at [the] completing for Babylon [of] seventy years I will visit you, and I will establish on you my word the good, to bring back you to the place the this.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will visit you, and I will fulfill for you {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} good word, to bring you back to this place.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: When Babylon's seventy years have been completed, I will come to your aid. I will keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} good promise to you and bring you back to this place.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Babylon will rule for seventy years. When those years are over, I will come and help you. I will do the good thing I promised and bring you back to this place.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Cuando se cumplan para Babilonia setenta años, {{plural_you:los|os}} visitaré, y cumpliré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} buena palabra, para {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} volver a este lugar.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Cuando se hayan cumplido los setenta años de Babilonia, vendré en {{plural_you:su ayuda|vuestra ayuda}}. Cumpliré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} buena promesa y {{plural_you:los|os}} haré volver a este lugar.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Babilonia dominará durante setenta años. Cuando terminen esos años, vendré a {{plural_you:ayudarlos|ayudaros}}. Haré el bien que {{plural_you:les|os}} prometí y {{plural_you:los|os}} traeré de vuelta a este lugar.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Quand soixante-dix ans seront accomplis pour Babylone, je vous visiterai, et j’accomplirai pour vous {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} bonne parole, en vous ramenant en ce lieu.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Quand les soixante-dix ans de Babylone seront accomplis, je viendrai à votre secours. Je tiendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} bonne promesse envers vous et je vous ramènerai en ce lieu.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Babylone dominera pendant soixante-dix ans. Quand ces années seront passées, je viendrai vous aider. Je ferai le bien que je vous ai promis et je vous ramènerai en ce lieu.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Miaka sabini itakapotimia kwa Babeli, nitawajia, nami nitawatimizia neno {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} jema, kuwarudisha mahali hapa.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Miaka sabini ya Babeli itakapotimia, nitakuja kuwasaidia. Nitatimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} njema kwenu na kuwarudisha mahali hapa.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Babeli itatawala kwa miaka sabini. Miaka hiyo itakapokwisha, nitakuja kuwasaidia. Nitafanya jambo jema nililoahidi na kuwarudisha mahali hapa.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Khi bảy mươi năm đã mãn cho Ba-by-lôn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thăm viếng các ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm trọn cho các ngươi lời tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mà đem các ngươi trở về nơi này.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Khi bảy mươi năm của Ba-by-lôn đã mãn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đến giúp đỡ các ngươi. Ta sẽ giữ lời hứa tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và đem các ngươi trở về nơi này.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ba-by-lôn sẽ cai trị trong bảy mươi năm. Khi những năm ấy đã qua, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đến giúp các ngươi. Ta sẽ làm điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa và đem các ngươi trở về nơi này.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 바빌론에서 70년이 차면, 내가 너희를 돌보고, 너희를 이곳으로 돌아오게 하겠다는 내 선한 말을 너희에게 이루겠다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 바빌론의 70년이 다 차면, 내가 너희를 찾아가 돌보겠다. 너희를 이곳으로 돌아오게 하겠다는 내 은혜로운 약속을 지키겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 바빌론이 70년 동안 다스릴 것이다. 그 세월이 끝나면 내가 너희를 찾아가 돕겠다. 내가 약속한 좋은 일을 이루어 너희를 이곳으로 다시 데려오겠다.

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Quando se completarem setenta anos para a Babilônia, eu os visitarei e cumprirei para vocês a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} boa palavra, de trazê-los de volta a este lugar.
pt.B: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Quando se completarem os setenta anos da Babilônia, virei em socorro de vocês. Cumprirei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} boa promessa e os trarei de volta a este lugar.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: A Babilônia vai dominar durante setenta anos. Quando esses anos terminarem, vou vir ajudar vocês. Vou fazer o bem que prometi e trazer vocês de volta a este lugar.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ ለባቢሎን ሰባ ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ እጎበኛችኋለሁ፤ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳችሁ ዘንድ መልካሙን ቃሌን ለእናንተ አጸናለሁ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ የባቢሎን ሰባ ዓመት ሲፈጸም ልረዳችሁ እመጣለሁ። ለእናንተ የሰጠሁትን መልካም ተስፋ እፈጽማለሁ፤ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳችኋለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ባቢሎን ለሰባ ዓመት ትገዛለች። እነዚያ ዓመታት ሲያበቁ መጥቼ እረዳችኋለሁ። የሰጠኋችሁን መልካም ተስፋ እፈጽማለሁ፤ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳችኋለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: जब बाबुल के लिए सत्तर वर्ष पूरे हो जाएँगे, तब मैं तुम्हारी सुधि लूँगा, और तुम्हें इस स्थान में लौटा लाकर अपना भला वचन तुम्हारे लिए पूरा करूँगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: जब बाबुल के सत्तर वर्ष पूरे हो जाएँगे, तब मैं तुम्हारी सहायता को आऊँगा। मैं तुमसे की गई अपनी भली प्रतिज्ञा पूरी करूँगा, और तुम्हें इस स्थान में लौटा लाऊँगा।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: बाबुल सत्तर वर्ष तक राज्य करेगा। जब वे वर्ष पूरे हो जाएँगे, तब मैं आकर तुम्हारी सहायता करूँगा। मैंने जिस भलाई का वादा किया है, वह मैं करूँगा, और तुम्हें इस स्थान में वापस ले आऊँगा।

ru.L: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Когда исполнятся для Вавилона семьдесят лет, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посещу вас и исполню для вас {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} доброе слово — верну вас в это место.
ru.B: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Когда исполнятся семьдесят лет Вавилона, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} приду вам на помощь. Я исполню {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} доброе обещание и верну вас в это место.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вавилон будет править семьдесят лет. Когда эти годы пройдут, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} приду и помогу вам. Я сделаю то доброе, что обещал, и верну вас в это место.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。バビロンのために七十年が満ちるとき、わたしはあなたがたを顧み、あなたがたに対するわたしの良い言葉を成就させ、あなたがたをこの場所に帰らせる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。バビロンの七十年が満ちたとき、わたしはあなたがたを顧みる。あなたがたへの恵みの約束を果たし、あなたがたをこの場所に連れ戻す。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。バビロンは七十年の間、国々を支配する。その年月が終わったとき、わたしはあなたたちを助けに来る。わたしが約束した良いことを行い、あなたたちをこの場所に連れ戻す。

uk.L: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Коли сповняться для Вавилону сімдесят років, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відвідаю вас і здійсню для вас {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} добре слово, щоб повернути вас на це місце.
uk.B: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Коли сповняться сімдесят років Вавилону, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прийду вам на допомогу. Я виконаю {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} добру обіцянку вам і поверну вас на це місце.
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Вавилон пануватиме сімдесят років. Коли ці роки минуть, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прийду й допоможу вам. Я зроблю те добре, що обіцяв, і поверну вас на це місце.

decisions.choice: seventy years for Babylon: the time Jeremiah had already named
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had said that the nations would serve the king of Babylon seventy years, and that after that God would punish Babylon (25:11-12). Later readers saw the promise fulfilled when the exiles returned (2 Chronicles 36:21-22; Ezra 1:1), and Daniel prayed over these words (Daniel 9:2).

decisions.choice: for Babylon: the seventy years are the time of Babylon's power
decisions.reason: The years are counted "for Babylon": the span of its rule, not the length of any one group's exile. Babylon's empire lasted from Nebuchadnezzar's victory in 605 BC to the fall of Babylon to Cyrus in 539 BC, close to seventy years; seventy is also the span of a full human life (Psalm 90:10). Either way, the exiles would not be going home soon, against what the prophets were telling them (verses 8-9; 28:3-4).

decisions.choice: I will visit you: I will turn my attention to you, here for your good
decisions.reason: The verb means to take notice of, to attend to someone. It can mean to come to help (Genesis 50:24; Exodus 4:31) or to punish (verse 32). Here it is for good, as the rest of the verse says.

decisions.choice: I will establish my good word: I will make my promise come true
decisions.reason: To "establish" a word is to carry it out (28:6; 33:14). The "good word" is God's promise of return, given in 24:6 and spelled out in the verses that follow.

decisions.choice: come to your aid (Balanced); come and help you (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Visit" in English suggests a social call; Balanced and Readable say what God's visit means here (m3).

decisions.choice: Babylon will rule for seventy years
decisions.reason: Readable says what "for Babylon" means (m2) in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "thăm viếng" (visit)
decisions.reason: Here God's visiting is for good (meaning decision m3), so Literal says "thăm viếng", which in Vietnamese carries kindness; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "돌보다" (L); "찾아가 돌보다" (B); "찾아가 돕다" (R) for "visit"
decisions.reason: Here God's "visiting" is for good (meaning decision m3); the same verb "돌보다" was used in 23:2, so the two senses stay linked in Korean.

decisions.choice: सत्तर वर्ष; सुधि लेना (L), सहायता को आना (B, R)
decisions.reason: The seventy years keep the wording of 25:11-12, 2 Chronicles 36:21 and Daniel 9:2. The verb paqad, which at 25:12 means "punish", here means God's attention for good (m3): Literal says सुधि लेना, Balanced and Readable say he will come to help, as the English does.

decisions.choice: семьдесят лет
decisions.reason: The seventy years keep the wording of 25:11-12, 2 Chronicles 36:21 and Daniel 9:2 in this translation, so the promise can be followed from one to the other.

decisions.choice: приду вам на помощь (B); приду и помогу вам (R)
decisions.reason: God's "visiting" here is coming to help; Literal keeps "посещу", Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'efqod 'etkhem "顧みる" (L, B), "助けに来る" (R), the visit for good (m3), as GEN 50:24 / EXO 3:16; devari hattov "わたしの良い言葉" (L), "恵みの約束" (B), "約束した良いこと" (R) (m4).
decisions.reason: paqad here is for the exiles' good, so not "罰する" as at 29:32.

source.text: כִּי֩ אָנֹכִ֨י יָדַ֜עְתִּי אֶת־הַמַּחֲשָׁבֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י חֹשֵׁ֥ב עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה מַחְשְׁב֤וֹת שָׁלוֹם֙ וְלֹ֣א לְרָעָ֔ה לָתֵ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם אַחֲרִ֥ית וְתִקְוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For I know the plans that I [am] planning for you, declaration of Yahweh, plans of peace and not for evil, to give to you a future and hope.

en.L: For I, I know the plans that I am planning for you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, plans of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.
en.B: For I know well what I have planned for you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I have planned peace for you, not disaster, so as to give you a future and a hope.
en.R: I know what I have planned for you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I plan to give you well-being, not trouble. I will give you a future and something to hope for.

es.L: Porque yo, yo conozco los planes que tengo para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, planes de paz y no de mal, para {{plural_you:darles|daros}} un futuro y una esperanza.
es.B: Porque yo sé bien lo que he planeado para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. He planeado para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} paz, y no desgracia, a fin de {{plural_you:darles|daros}} un futuro y una esperanza.
es.R: Yo sé lo que he planeado para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Planeo {{plural_you:darles|daros}} bienestar, y no problemas. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} daré un futuro y algo que esperar.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je connais les projets que je forme pour vous, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, projets de paix et non de malheur, pour vous donner un avenir et une espérance.
fr.B: Car je sais bien ce que j’ai projeté pour vous, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ce que j’ai projeté pour vous, c’est la paix, et non le malheur, pour vous donner un avenir et une espérance.
fr.R: Je sais ce que j’ai prévu pour vous, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. J’ai prévu de vous donner le bien-être, et non des malheurs. Je vous donnerai un avenir et une raison d’espérer.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} najua mipango ninayowapangia, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mipango ya amani wala si ya mabaya, kuwapa wakati ujao na tumaini.
sw.B: Kwa maana najua vema yale niliyowapangia, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nimewapangia amani, si maafa, ili kuwapa wakati ujao na tumaini.
sw.R: Najua niliyowapangia, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nimepanga kuwapa ustawi, si taabu. Nitawapa wakati ujao na kitu cha kutumainia.

vi.L: Vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết những ý định {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang định cho các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, là những ý định bình an chứ không phải tai họa, để ban cho các ngươi một tương lai và một niềm hy vọng.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết rõ những điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã định cho các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Ta đã định cho các ngươi được bình an chứ không phải gặp tai họa, để ban cho các ngươi một tương lai và một niềm hy vọng.
vi.R: Ta biết những điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã định cho các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta định cho các ngươi được an lành, chứ không phải gặp hoạn nạn. Ta sẽ ban cho các ngươi một tương lai và điều để hy vọng.

ko.L: 내가 너희를 위하여 계획하는 계획들을 나는 알고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그것은 재앙이 아니라 평안을 위한 계획이며, 너희에게 미래와 희망을 주려는 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 너희를 위하여 세운 계획은 내가 잘 알고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그것은 재앙이 아니라 평안을 주려는 계획이며, 너희에게 미래와 희망을 주려는 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너희를 위해 무엇을 계획했는지 나는 안다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 너희에게 괴로움이 아니라 평안을 주려고 한다. 너희에게 앞날과 바랄 것을 주려고 한다.

pt.L: Pois eu, eu conheço os projetos que estou projetando para vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, projetos de paz e não de mal, para dar a vocês um futuro e uma esperança.
pt.B: Pois eu sei bem o que planejei para vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. O que planejei para vocês é paz, e não desgraça, para lhes dar um futuro e uma esperança.
pt.R: Eu sei o que planejei para vocês, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Quero dar a vocês bem-estar, e não sofrimento. Vou dar a vocês um futuro e uma razão para ter esperança.

am.L: እኔ ለእናንተ የማቅደውን ዕቅድ እኔ አውቃለሁና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ መጪ ዘመንንና ተስፋን እሰጣችሁ ዘንድ የሰላም ዕቅድ እንጂ የክፉ ነገር ዕቅድ አይደለም።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं, मैं जानता हूँ उन योजनाओं को जो मैं तुम्हारे लिए बना रहा हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, शान्ति की योजनाएँ, बुराई की नहीं, कि तुम्हें भविष्य और आशा दूँ।
hi.B: क्योंकि मैं भली भाँति जानता हूँ कि मैंने तुम्हारे लिए क्या ठाना है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। मैंने तुम्हारे लिए शान्ति ठानी है, विपत्ति नहीं, कि तुम्हें भविष्य और आशा दूँ।
hi.R: मैं जानता हूँ कि मैंने तुम्हारे लिए क्या सोच रखा है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। मैं तुम्हारा भला करना चाहता हूँ, बुरा नहीं। मैं तुम्हें एक भविष्य दूँगा और ऐसा कुछ जिसकी तुम आशा रख सको।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знаю замыслы, которые {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} замышляю о вас, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — замыслы мира, а не зла, чтобы дать вам будущее и надежду.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хорошо знаю, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} задумал для вас, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Я задумал для вас мир, а не беду, чтобы дать вам будущее и надежду.
ru.R: Я знаю, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} задумал для вас, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Я хочу дать вам благополучие, а не беду. Я дам вам будущее и то, на что можно надеяться.

ja.L: わたし、わたしこそが、あなたがたのために思い計っている計らいを知っているからだ――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。それは平和のための計らいであって、災いのためではなく、あなたがたに将来と希望を与えるためのものである。
ja.B: あなたがたのためにわたしが思い描いている計画は、わたし自身がよく知っている、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。それは災いではなく平和をもたらす計画であり、あなたがたに将来と希望を与えるものだ。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたたちのために考えている計画を、よく知っている、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。わたしは、あなたたちを苦しめるのではなく、幸せにしようと考えている。あなたたちに未来と、望みを与えようとしているのだ。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знаю задуми, які {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} задумую щодо вас, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, задуми миру, а не зла, щоб дати вам майбутнє і надію.
uk.B: Бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} добре знаю, що задумав для вас, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я задумав для вас мир, а не лихо, щоб дати вам майбутнє і надію.
uk.R: Я знаю, що задумав для вас, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я хочу дати вам добробут, а не біду. Я дам вам майбутнє і те, на що можна надіятися.

decisions.choice: plans for you: God's purpose for the exiles as a people
decisions.reason: The "you" is plural and means the exiles of Judah as a community. The promise belongs to the setting of verse 10: after the seventy years God will bring his people back, and the plans of peace are his purpose for the nation's future. Many readers take comfort from the verse for their own lives, and it does show what kind of God he is: his final purpose for his people is good. But it is first a promise to a people in exile, not a pledge of success to each person, and some of those who first heard it would die in Babylon before it came true.

decisions.choice: the plans that I am planning: God's settled intentions
decisions.reason: The noun and the verb come from one root: "the plans I plan". Elsewhere God says that he is planning a plan of disaster against Judah (18:11; compare 49:20; 50:45). Here the same words describe a plan of peace. The participle "I am planning" shows that the plan is already in his mind.

decisions.choice: plans of peace and not of evil: plans for well-being, not for disaster
decisions.reason: "Peace" is the same word as in verse 7: wholeness and well-being. "Evil" here means harm or disaster, not moral wickedness (compare 21:10; 24:5).

decisions.choice: a future and a hope: a hopeful future
decisions.reason: The first word means what comes afterward: the end of a matter, its outcome, the future. With "hope" it may name two things, or one thing in two words: a future full of hope. The same pair is used in 31:17 ("there is hope for your future") and Proverbs 23:18.

decisions.choice: I: said twice, for emphasis
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" is written out before both verbs, though the verb forms already say "I". The emphasis sets God's knowledge of his own plans against the prophets' claims (verses 8-9).

decisions.choice: what I have planned for you ... I have planned peace for you, not disaster
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the plans in verbs, as English often does, and starts a new sentence for the second half; "know well" carries the emphatic "I" (m5).

decisions.choice: well-being, not trouble; a future and something to hope for
decisions.reason: Readable says "well-being" for "peace", as in verse 7, and gives "hope" as a phrase young readers can follow.

decisions.choice: planes de paz y no de mal ... un futuro y una esperanza (Literal); paz, y no desgracia (Balanced); bienestar, y no problemas (Readable)
decisions.reason: A well-known verse; the wording is drafted from the Hebrew gloss ("plans", "peace and not evil", "a future and a hope") rather than from a familiar version.

decisions.choice: mipango ninayowapangia
decisions.reason: "Mipango" (plans) and "kupanga" give the Hebrew noun and verb from one root, as the English does; the wording is kept apart from the familiar Union Version line.

decisions.choice: "les projets que je forme" (L); "ce que j'ai projeté" (B); "ce que j'ai prévu" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun and verb share one root; French keeps them close ("projets ... projeté", "prévu") and avoids "pensées", which is the wording of well-known versions; Readable repeats "bien-être" from verse 7.

decisions.choice: "bình an ... tai họa"
decisions.reason: "Bình an" is the key term for shalom, as in verse 7; the opposite is the "tai họa" of 18:8, not wickedness. This well-known verse is drafted from the Hebrew, not from a familiar version.

decisions.choice: "평안 ... 재앙" (L, B); "평안 ... 괴로움" (R)
decisions.reason: "Plans of *shalom* and not of evil" means well-being, not disaster (meaning decision m3); "재앙" keeps God from being heard planning wickedness, as in 18:8. The verse is widely known; the wording was drafted from the Hebrew and checked against familiar versions.

decisions.choice: projetos que estou projetando (L); o que planejei ... é paz, e não desgraça (B); bem-estar, e não sofrimento (R)
alternatives: os planos que tenho para vocês
decisions.reason: This well-known verse is drafted from the Hebrew, in this translation's own words, not in the familiar wording of other Portuguese Bibles. Literal keeps the noun and verb of one root (m2) with "projetos que estou projetando"; Balanced puts the plans in a verb, as the English does. "Paz" is the shalom of verse 7 (m3) and "mal", "desgraça" the harm, not wickedness, as 21:10 has it. The "vocês" is the exiles as a people (m1).

decisions.choice: "ዕቅድ" (plans) and "መጪ ዘመንና ተስፋ" (a future and a hope)
decisions.reason: A much-loved verse, drafted fresh from the Hebrew: "ዕቅድ" says God's settled intentions; Literal keeps the doubled "I" ("እኔ … እኔ አውቃለሁ") and the noun repeated in "plans that I am planning" ("የማቅደውን ዕቅድ").

decisions.choice: शान्ति की योजनाएँ, बुराई की नहीं (L); शान्ति ... विपत्ति नहीं (B); भला ... बुरा नहीं (R); भविष्य और आशा
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew: the plans (maḥshavot) are योजनाएँ at Literal and God's settled purpose (ठानना) at Balanced; shalom is शान्ति, as in verse 7, against raʿ (evil, disaster); "a future and a hope" is भविष्य और आशा. The familiar Hindi Old Version wording is avoided.

decisions.choice: замыслы мира (L); задумал для вас мир (B); благополучие (R)
decisions.reason: Shalom keeps the word "мир" at Literal and Balanced, as in verse 7, and is "благополучие" at Readable; the plans are given as a noun at Literal and as a verb at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: 'anokhi yada'ti, 'anokhi choshev (m5) "わたし、わたしこそが" (L), "わたし自身が" (B); hammachashavot ... machshevot shalom "思い計っている計らい ... 平和のための計らい" (L, keeping the repeated root), "計画" (B, R); shalom "平和" (L, B), "幸せ" (R, the English R "well-being"); 'acharit vetiqvah "将来と希望" (L, B), "未来と、望み" (R) (m4).
decisions.reason: Drafted fresh from the Hebrew; the familiar Japanese wording of this verse is avoided while keeping the common nouns 平和, 将来, 希望.

decisions.choice: and you will call: what will follow from God's plans
decisions.reason: The verbs carry on from verses 10-11 and describe what the people will do when God turns to them. It is not a condition laid down first; God's promise and the people's turning to him go together.

decisions.choice: you will pray to me and I will listen: the prayer of the exiles
decisions.reason: Solomon asked that when Israel was taken captive to an enemy land, and prayed to God there, God would hear and forgive them (1 Kings 8:46-50). Moses said that in exile they would turn back to God (Deuteronomy 4:29-31; 30:1-3).

decisions.choice: come: come to God in prayer
alternatives: walk, set out (on the way back)
decisions.reason: The verb "go" or "come" stands between "call" and "pray" and means coming before God; some take it as setting out on the way home, but it most likely belongs with the prayer.

decisions.choice: Then
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show with "Then" that this follows from verses 10-11. Balanced says "hear" for the last verb, which in Hebrew is "listen" and also "answer".

decisions.choice: "そのとき" (B, R) for the English "Then" (m1, what follows from God's plans); B, R "祈り(を聞く)" makes the object of shama' explicit.

decisions.choice: seek and find, with all your heart: the words of Deuteronomy 4:29
decisions.reason: Moses foretold that in exile Israel would seek the LORD and find him, when they searched for him with all their heart and soul (Deuteronomy 4:29). The letter uses the same two verbs for seeking and the same "with all your heart": what Moses foretold is now about to happen.

decisions.choice: when: the condition for finding
decisions.reason: The word can mean "when", "if" or "because", as in Deuteronomy 4:29. Wholehearted seeking is the way God is found.

decisions.choice: with all your heart: with the whole mind and will
decisions.reason: The heart is the center of thought and will. To seek with all the heart is to seek with nothing held back (Deuteronomy 6:5; Jeremiah 24:7).

decisions.choice: seek, search for (Balanced); look for (Readable)
decisions.reason: Each level follows its wording of Deuteronomy 4:29 so that the echo can be heard. Literal brackets the second "me", which the Hebrew leaves out.

decisions.choice: "vous me trouverez", with no brackets
decisions.reason: The Hebrew leaves out the second "me"; French needs the object pronoun before the verb, where brackets would break the word order, so Literal writes it plainly.

decisions.choice: "찾다 ... 만나다" (L, B); "찾다 ... 찾아내다" (R)
decisions.reason: The pair "seek and find" of Deuteronomy 4:29 (meaning decision m1); Korean "찾다" covers seeking, and "만나다" or "찾아내다" says that the search succeeds.

decisions.choice: buscar ... achar ... procurar de todo o coração
decisions.reason: The verse takes up Deuteronomy 4:29 (m1), and Portuguese keeps the verbs that verse has, "buscar", "achar", "procurar de todo o coração", so the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: ढूँढ़ना ... पाना ... खोज करना; सारे हृदय (L), पूरे हृदय (B), पूरे दिल (R)
decisions.reason: The verse echoes Deuteronomy 4:29 (m1), so each level keeps the wording of Deuteronomy 4:29 in this translation: ढूँढ़ोगे ... पाओगे ... खोज करोगे, with the heart as there.

decisions.choice: искать ... всем сердцем
decisions.reason: The promise echoes Deuteronomy 4:29; Russian keeps the plain verb "искать" at every level so the echo is heard.

decisions.choice: biqqashtem ... umetsatem ... ki tidreshuni bekhol levavkhem "捜し求め……見いだす……心を尽くしてわたしを求める" (L, B), "探す……見つける" (R), echoing DEU 4:29 (m1); L and B keep the condition after the main clause as the Hebrew, R puts it before "見つける" (m2).
decisions.reason: Two verbs of seeking (biqqesh, darash) as "捜し求める / 求める" (L, B).

records.literal_gloss: And I will be found by you, declaration of Yahweh, and I will turn your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations and from all the places where I drove you there, declaration of Yahweh, and I will bring back you to the place where I exiled you from there.

en.L: And I will let {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} be found by you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will restore your fortunes, and I will gather you from all the nations and from all the places where I have driven you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will bring you back to the place from which I exiled you.
en.B: I will let you find {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will restore your fortunes and gather you from all the nations and all the places where I have driven you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will bring you back to the place from which I sent you into exile.
en.R: I will let you find {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will make things good again for you. I will gather you from all the nations and all the places where I have scattered you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will bring you back to the place from which I sent you away as captives.

sw.L: Nami nitaonekana kwenu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami nitawarudishia mafanikio yenu, nami nitawakusanya kutoka mataifa yote na kutoka mahali pote nilipowafukuzia, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami nitawarudisha mahali ambapo niliwahamisha kutoka hapo.

sw.R: Nitawaacha mnipate, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nitayafanya mambo yenu kuwa mema tena. Nitawakusanya kutoka mataifa yote na mahali pote nilipowatawanya, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nitawarudisha mahali nilipowatoa na kuwapeleka kama mateka.

vi.L: Ta sẽ để cho các ngươi gặp Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của các ngươi; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm các ngươi lại từ mọi dân tộc và từ mọi nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi các ngươi đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem các ngươi trở về nơi mà từ đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã bắt các ngươi lưu đày.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너희에게 나를 찾게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그리고 내가 너희의 운명을 돌이키고, 내가 너희를 쫓아낸 모든 민족과 모든 곳에서 너희를 모으겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그리고 내가 너희를 사로잡혀 가게 한 그곳으로 너희를 돌아오게 하겠다.

ko.R: 내가 너희가 나를 만나게 해 주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 너희를 다시 잘되게 해 주겠다. 내가 너희를 흩어 보낸 모든 민족과 모든 곳에서 너희를 모으겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그리고 너희를 포로로 보냈던 이곳으로 너희를 다시 데려오겠다.

am.L: በእናንተም እገኛለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ዕድል ፈንታችሁንም እመልሳለሁ፤ ከሕዝቦች ሁሉና ካሳደድኋችሁ ስፍራ ሁሉ እሰበስባችኋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ካፈለስኳችሁም ስፍራ ወደዚያው እመልሳችኋለሁ።
am.B: እንድታገኙኝ አደርጋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ዕድል ፈንታችሁን እመልሳለሁ፤ ካሳደድኋችሁ ሕዝቦችና ስፍራዎች ሁሉ እሰበስባችኋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ማርኬ ከሰደድኋችሁም ስፍራ ወደዚያው እመልሳችኋለሁ።
am.R: እንድታገኙኝ አደርጋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ሁኔታችሁን እንደ ገና መልካም አደርገዋለሁ። ከበተንኳችሁ ሕዝቦችና ስፍራዎች ሁሉ እሰበስባችኋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ተማርካችሁ እንድትሄዱ ካደረግኋችሁ ስፍራ ወደዚያው እመልሳችኋለሁ።

hi.L: और मैं तुम्हें मिल जाऊँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और मैं तुम्हारी दशा फेर दूँगा, और तुम्हें सब जातियों में से और उन सब स्थानों में से इकट्ठा करूँगा जहाँ मैंने तुम्हें भगा दिया है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और तुम्हें उस स्थान में लौटा लाऊँगा जहाँ से मैंने तुम्हें बंधुआई में भेजा।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हें मिल जाऊँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। मैं तुम्हारी दशा फेर दूँगा और तुम्हें सब देशों और उन सब स्थानों से इकट्ठा करूँगा जहाँ मैंने तुम्हें भगा दिया है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और तुम्हें उस स्थान में लौटा लाऊँगा जहाँ से मैंने तुम्हें बंधुआई में भेजा था।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें मिल जाऊँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। मैं तुम्हारे दिन फिर से अच्छे कर दूँगा। जिन जिन देशों और स्थानों में मैंने तुम्हें तितर-बितर किया है, वहाँ से मैं तुम्हें इकट्ठा करूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। मैं तुम्हें उस स्थान में वापस ले आऊँगा जहाँ से मैंने तुम्हें बंदी बनाकर भेजा था।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам вам найти себя, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — и восстановлю ваше благополучие, и соберу вас из всех народов и из всех мест, куда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изгнал вас, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — и верну вас в место, откуда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} переселил вас.
ru.B: Я позволю вам найти {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Я восстановлю ваше благополучие и соберу вас из всех народов и из всех мест, куда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изгнал вас, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, и верну вас в то место, откуда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отправил вас в изгнание.
ru.R: Я позволю вам найти {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Я снова сделаю вашу жизнь хорошей. Я соберу вас из всех народов и из всех мест, куда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вас рассеял, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Я верну вас в то место, откуда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отправил вас в плен.

ja.L: わたしはあなたがたに見いだされる――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。わたしはあなたがたの繁栄を元どおりにし、わたしがあなたがたを追いやったすべての国々とすべての場所から、あなたがたを集める――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。そして、わたしがあなたがたを捕らえ移したその場所から、[元の]場所にあなたがたを帰らせる。
ja.B: わたしはあなたがたに見いだされる、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。わたしはあなたがたの繁栄を回復し、わたしがあなたがたを追いやったすべての国々、すべての場所から、あなたがたを集める、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。そして、わたしがあなたがたを捕囚として送り出したその場所へ、あなたがたを連れ戻す。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたたちがわたしを見つけるようにする、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。わたしは、あなたたちを再び幸せにする。わたしがあなたたちを散らしたすべての国々、すべての場所から、あなたたちを集める、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。そして、わたしがあなたたちを捕虜として送り出したその場所に、あなたたちを連れ戻す。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам вам знайти себе, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і поверну вашу долю, і зберу вас з усіх народів і з усіх місць, куди {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вигнав вас, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і поверну вас на місце, звідки {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вас вигнав.
uk.B: Я дам вам знайти {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я поверну вашу долю і зберу вас з усіх народів і з усіх місць, куди {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вигнав вас, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і поверну вас на місце, звідки {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відправив вас у вигнання.
uk.R: Я дам вам знайти {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я знову зроблю вам добро. Я зберу вас з усіх народів і з усіх місць, куди {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вас розсіяв, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я поверну вас на місце, звідки {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відіслав вас у полон.

decisions.choice: I will be found by you: I will let myself be found
decisions.reason: The verb form means that God allows himself to be found by those who seek him (Isaiah 55:6; 65:1; 1 Chronicles 28:9). Finding him is his gift, not the seeker's achievement.

decisions.choice: I will turn your captivity: I will restore your fortunes
alternatives: I will bring back your captives
decisions.reason: The phrase is literally "turn your turning". It can mean to bring back the captives, and so it was long translated "turn your captivity", but it is also used where there is no captivity (Job 42:10) and means to restore what was lost, to turn a people's lot around. In this verse both senses fit, since the captives are to be brought home.

decisions.choice: your fortunes: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have a slightly different form of the noun; the scribes marked the more usual form to be read aloud (qere). The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: from all the nations and all the places: a scattering wider than Babylon
decisions.reason: The promise looks beyond the exiles in Babylon to all of Israel's scattered people, as Moses foretold (Deuteronomy 30:3-4; compare 23:3).

decisions.choice: the Greek has a shorter verse
decisions.reason: The Greek translation has only "and I will appear to you" and lacks the rest of the verse. The Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: I will let you find me
decisions.reason: Balanced turns the passive "be found by you" into an active sentence, as English prefers.

decisions.choice: make things good again for you; scattered
decisions.reason: Readable says what "restore your fortunes" means (m2) and says "scattered" for "driven".

decisions.choice: restauraré su suerte (Literal, Balanced); Haré que todo vuelva a ir bien (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Restore the fortunes" keeps the wording the terms note sets (Psalm 14:7; Psalm 126:4).

decisions.choice: nitawarudishia mafanikio yenu (Literal, Balanced); nitayafanya mambo yenu kuwa mema tena (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording used for *shuv shevut* ("restore the fortunes") in this block, as the English note sets: the whole restoration, not only the return of captives.

decisions.choice: "je rétablirai votre sort" (L, B); "je rendrai votre situation de nouveau heureuse" (R)
decisions.reason: Shuv shevut as the Jeremiah note sets it: "restore the fortunes" at Literal and Balanced, "make things good again" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "phục hồi cơ đồ" (L, B); "làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại" (R) for shuv shevut
decisions.reason: One wording for "restore the fortunes" at each level, used where it returns in 30-33. "Cơ đồ" covers a people's whole state and wealth, as the meaning decision reads it, not only the return of captives; "trở về" is kept for coming home.

decisions.choice: "운명을 돌이키다" (L); "형편을 회복시키다" (B); "다시 잘되게 해 주다" (R) for *shuv shevut*
decisions.reason: The wording for "restore the fortunes" through Jeremiah (29:14 to 49:39), one form per level (meaning decision m2). Literal follows the English "restore the fortunes" rather than "turn the captivity"; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: me deixarei achar (no span); restaurarei a sorte (L, B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the passive with a reflexive, "eu me deixarei achar" (m1); that "me" goes with the subject "eu", which takes no span, so the English "myself" span has none here. Balanced and Readable say "que vocês me achem", with the span, as the English does. "Restaurar a sorte" (L, B) is the wording of Deuteronomy 30:3 in Portuguese for the phrase (m2).

decisions.choice: restore the fortunes: "ዕድል ፈንታን መለሰ" (Literal, Balanced); Readable as the English level
decisions.reason: Kept for the same Hebrew phrase in 30:3, 18; 31:23.

decisions.choice: "поверну вашу долю" (L, B), "знову зроблю вам добро" (R) for restoring the fortunes, here and wherever it returns
decisions.reason: Follows the English levels and the book-wide choice in the Jeremiah terms note; the phrase means a reversal of their whole condition, not only the return of captives.

decisions.choice: दशा फेर देना (L, B); दिन फिर से अच्छे कर देना (R)
decisions.reason: "Restore your fortunes" keeps the wording of Deuteronomy 30:3 and Jeremiah 32:44 in this translation; the same at 30:3, 18 and 31:23.

decisions.choice: восстановлю ваше благополучие (L, B); снова сделаю вашу жизнь хорошей (R)
decisions.reason: "Restore your fortunes" takes the wording of Deuteronomy 30:3 in this translation; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: shavti 'et shevutkhem "繁栄を元どおりにし" (L), "繁栄を回復し" (B), "再び幸せにする" (R), the form of AMO 9:14, JOL 4:1, ZEP 3:20 (m2, footnoted); nimtse'ti lakhem "見いだされる" (L, B), "わたしを見つけるようにする" (R) (m1).
decisions.reason: The prophets' settled rendering of shuv shevut.

records.literal_gloss: For you have said: Has raised up for us Yahweh prophets [in] Babylon.

en.L: For you have said, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has raised up prophets for us in Babylon.'
en.B: You have been saying, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has raised up prophets for us here in Babylon.'
en.R: You say, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has given us prophets here in Babylon.'

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:han|habéis}} dicho: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos ha levantado profetas en Babilonia”.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes han estado|Vosotros habéis estado}} diciendo: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos ha levantado profetas aquí en Babilonia”.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes dicen|Vosotros decís}}: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos ha dado profetas aquí en Babilonia”.

fr.L: Car vous avez dit : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous a suscité des prophètes à Babylone.”
fr.B: Vous dites : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous a suscité des prophètes ici, à Babylone.”

sw.L: Kwa maana mmesema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametuinulia manabii [huko] Babeli.'
sw.B: Mmekuwa mkisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametuinulia manabii hapa Babeli.'

vi.L: Vì các ngươi đã nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dấy lên cho chúng ta những nhà tiên tri tại Ba-by-lôn.'
vi.B: Các ngươi cứ nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dấy lên cho chúng ta những nhà tiên tri ngay tại Ba-by-lôn này.'
vi.R: Các ngươi nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho chúng ta những nhà tiên tri ngay tại Ba-by-lôn này.'

ko.L: 너희가 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바빌론에서 우리를 위하여 예언자들을 일으키셨다.' 하고 말했으므로,
ko.B: 너희는 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여기 바빌론에서도 우리에게 예언자들을 일으켜 주셨다.' 하고 말해 왔다.
ko.R: 너희는 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여기 바빌론에서도 우리에게 예언자들을 주셨다.' 하고 말한다.

pt.L: Pois vocês disseram: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} levantou para nós profetas na Babilônia.'
pt.B: Vocês têm dito: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} levantou profetas para nós aqui na Babilônia.'
pt.R: Vocês dizem: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} nos deu profetas aqui na Babilônia.'

am.L: እናንተ፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በባቢሎን ነቢያትን አስነሣልን” ብላችኋልና።
am.B: እናንተ፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እዚህ በባቢሎን ነቢያትን አስነሥቶልናል” ትላላችሁ።
am.R: እናንተ፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እዚህ በባቢሎን ነቢያትን ሰጥቶናል” ትላላችሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि तुमने कहा है, '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बाबुल में हमारे लिए भविष्यद्वक्ता खड़े किए हैं।'
hi.B: तुम कहते आए हो, '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यहाँ बाबुल में हमारे लिए भविष्यद्वक्ता खड़े किए हैं।'

ru.L: Ведь вы сказали: “{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} воздвиг нам пророков в Вавилоне.”
ru.B: Вы говорите: “{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} воздвиг нам пророков здесь, в Вавилоне.”
ru.R: Вы говорите: “{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал нам пророков здесь, в Вавилоне.”

ja.L: あなたがたは、『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はバビロンでわたしたちのために預言者たちを起こされた』と言ったからだ。
ja.B: あなたがたは、『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ここバビロンで、わたしたちのために預言者たちを起こしてくださった』と言っている。
ja.R: あなたたちは、『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ここバビロンで、わたしたちに預言者たちを与えてくださった』と言っている。

uk.L: Бо ви сказали: “{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} поставив нам пророків у Вавилоні”.
uk.B: Ви кажете: “{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} поставив нам пророків тут, у Вавилоні”.
uk.R: Ви кажете: “{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав нам пророків тут, у Вавилоні”.

decisions.choice: for you have said: the reason for what follows in verses 21-23
alternatives: Since you have said ... (answered in verse 16)
decisions.reason: The sentence begins "because" or "since", and the answer to it comes in verses 21-23, which name two of these prophets in Babylon and their fate. Verses 16-20 stand between, as a message about those still in Jerusalem. Some read verse 15 with verse 16 instead: since you trust these prophets, hear what the LORD says about Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: prophets in Babylon: men among the exiles who spoke in the LORD's name
decisions.reason: There were prophets among the exiles who promised a quick return (verses 8-9, 21, 24-28). Ezekiel also prophesied among the exiles from 593 BC (Ezekiel 1:1-3), but the letter speaks of the prophets the exiles trusted against Jeremiah's word.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks
decisions.reason: The exiles' words are quoted inside the letter, so they take single quotation marks.

decisions.choice: here in Babylon (Balanced, Readable); has given us (Readable)
decisions.reason: The speakers are in Babylon, so Balanced and Readable say "here". Readable says "given" for "raised up".

decisions.choice: The exiles quoted speak of God with respect forms ("起こされた", "起こしてくださった"), as the people speaking of God in the JER conventions; their words in 『』 inside the letter's 「」.
decisions.reason: JER-1 register (people quoted).

source.text: כִּי־כֹ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַיּוֹשֵׁב֙ אֶל־כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֔ד וְאֶל־כָּל־הָעָ֔ם הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את אֲחֵיכֶ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־יָצְא֥וּ אִתְּכֶ֖ם בַּגּוֹלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh concerning the king who sits on [the] throne of David and concerning all the people who dwell in the city the this, your brothers who not went out with you into the exile:

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning the king who sits on the throne of David and concerning all the people who live in this city, your {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} who did not go out with you into exile:
en.B: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this about the king who sits on David's throne and about all the people who live in this city, your {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} who did not go with you into exile:
en.R: But this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says about the king who rules from David's throne, and about all the people who still live in Jerusalem, your relatives who were not taken away with you:

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca del rey que se sienta en el trono de David, y acerca de todo el pueblo que habita en esta ciudad, {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}} que no salieron con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al destierro:
es.B: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca del rey que se sienta en el trono de David, y acerca de todo el pueblo que vive en esta ciudad, {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}} que no fueron con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} al destierro:
es.R: Pero esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca del rey que gobierna desde el trono de David, y acerca de toda la gente que todavía vive en Jerusalén, {{plural_you:sus parientes|vuestros parientes}} que no fueron llevados con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}:

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet du roi qui siège sur le trône de David et au sujet de tout le peuple qui habite cette ville, vos {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui ne sont pas partis avec vous en exil :
fr.B: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet du roi qui siège sur le trône de David et au sujet de tout le peuple qui habite cette ville, vos {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui ne sont pas partis avec vous en exil :
fr.R: Mais voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet du roi qui règne sur le trône de David et de tous les gens qui habitent encore à Jérusalem, vos proches qu’on n’a pas emmenés avec vous :

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kuhusu mfalme aketiye juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, na kuhusu watu wote wakaao katika mji huu, ndugu zenu ambao hawakutoka pamoja nanyi kwenda uhamishoni:
sw.B: Lakini hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu mfalme aketiye juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, na kuhusu watu wote wanaoishi katika mji huu, ndugu zenu ambao hawakwenda pamoja nanyi uhamishoni:
sw.R: Lakini hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu mfalme anayetawala kutoka kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, na kuhusu watu wote ambao bado wanaishi Yerusalemu, ndugu zenu ambao hawakuchukuliwa pamoja nanyi:

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về vua đang ngồi trên ngai Đa-vít và về toàn dân đang sống trong thành này, là anh em của các ngươi, những người đã không ra đi lưu đày với các ngươi:
vi.B: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về vua đang ngồi trên ngai Đa-vít và về toàn dân đang sống trong thành này, là anh em của các ngươi, những người không bị đi lưu đày với các ngươi:
vi.R: Nhưng đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về vua đang cai trị trên ngai Đa-vít, và về mọi người còn sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, là bà con của các ngươi, những người không bị bắt đi với các ngươi:

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗의 왕좌에 앉은 왕과, 이 성에 사는 모든 백성, 곧 너희와 함께 포로로 나가지 않은 너희 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}에 대하여 이와 같이 말씀하신다.
ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗의 왕좌에 앉아 있는 왕과, 이 성에 사는 모든 백성, 곧 너희와 함께 포로로 끌려가지 않은 너희 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하신다.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗의 왕좌에 앉아 다스리는 왕과, 아직 예루살렘에 사는 모든 백성, 곧 너희와 함께 끌려가지 않은 너희 친척들에 대하여 하시는 말씀이다.

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} a respeito do rei que se assenta no trono de Davi e a respeito de todo o povo que habita nesta cidade, os seus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} que não saíram com vocês para o exílio:
pt.B: Mas assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} a respeito do rei que se assenta no trono de Davi e a respeito de todo o povo que mora nesta cidade, os seus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} que não foram com vocês para o exílio:
pt.R: Mas é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz a respeito do rei que governa do trono de Davi e a respeito de todo o povo que ainda mora em Jerusalém, os parentes de vocês que não foram levados com vocês:

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ስለ ተቀመጠው ንጉሥ፣ በዚህችም ከተማ ስለሚኖሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፣ ከእናንተ ጋር ወደ ምርኮ ስላልወጡት ስለ {{gender:ወንድሞቻችሁና እኅቶቻችሁ|ወንድሞቻችሁ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦
am.B: ነገር ግን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ስለ ተቀመጠው ንጉሥና በዚህች ከተማ ስለሚኖሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ፣ ከእናንተ ጋር ወደ ምርኮ ስላልሄዱት ስለ {{gender:ወንድሞቻችሁና እኅቶቻችሁ|ወንድሞቻችሁ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦
am.R: ነገር ግን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ሆኖ ስለሚገዛው ንጉሥና አሁንም በኢየሩሳሌም ስለሚኖሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ፣ ከእናንተ ጋር ተማርከው ስላልተወሰዱት ዘመዶቻችሁ እንዲህ ይላል፦

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उस राजा के विषय में जो दाऊद की गद्दी पर बैठा है, और इस नगर में रहनेवाले सब लोगों के विषय में, तुम्हारे उन {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}} के विषय में जो तुम्हारे साथ बंधुआई में नहीं निकले, यों कहते हैं:
hi.B: पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उस राजा के विषय में जो दाऊद की गद्दी पर बैठा है, और इस नगर में रहनेवाले सब लोगों के विषय में, तुम्हारे उन {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}} के विषय में जो तुम्हारे साथ बंधुआई में नहीं गए, यह कहते हैं:
hi.R: पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उस राजा के बारे में जो दाऊद की गद्दी पर बैठकर राज्य करता है, और उन सब लोगों के बारे में जो अब भी यरूशलेम में रहते हैं, तुम्हारे उन रिश्तेदारों के बारे में जो तुम्हारे साथ नहीं ले जाए गए, यह कहते हैं:

ru.L: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о царе, сидящем на престоле Давида, и обо всём народе, живущем в этом городе, о ваших {{gender:братьях и сёстрах|братьях}}, которые не вышли с вами в изгнание:
ru.B: Но так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о царе, который сидит на престоле Давида, и обо всём народе, который живёт в этом городе, о ваших {{gender:братьях и сёстрах|братьях}}, которые не пошли с вами в изгнание:
ru.R: Но вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о царе, который правит с престола Давида, и обо всех людях, которые ещё живут в Иерусалиме, о ваших родных, которых не увели вместе с вами:

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ダビデの王座に着いている王について、またこの町に住んでいるすべての民、すなわち、あなたがたと一緒に捕囚として出て行かなかったあなたがたの{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}について、こう言われる。
ja.B: しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ダビデの王座に着いている王と、この町に住んでいるすべての民、つまり、あなたがたと共に捕囚として行かなかったあなたがたの{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}について、こう言われる。
ja.R: しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ダビデの王座から国を治めている王と、まだエルサレムに住んでいるすべての人々について、こう言われる。それは、あなたたちと一緒に連れて行かれなかった、あなたたちの同胞のことだ。

uk.L: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про царя, що сидить на престолі Давида, і про весь народ, що живе в цьому місті, ваших {{gender:братів і сестер|братів}}, які не вийшли з вами у вигнання:
uk.B: Але так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про царя, що сидить на престолі Давида, і про весь народ, що живе в цьому місті, ваших {{gender:братів і сестер|братів}}, які не пішли з вами у вигнання:
uk.R: Але так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про царя, який править з престолу Давида, і про всіх людей, які ще живуть у Єрусалимі, ваших родичів, яких не забрали разом з вами:

decisions.choice: verses 16-20 are not in the Greek translation
decisions.reason: The Greek translation goes straight from verse 15 to verse 21. Verses 16-20 repeat words found elsewhere in Jeremiah (24:8-10; 25:4), and some think they were added to the letter; others think the Greek lost them because verse 15 and verse 20 both end with "Babylon". The Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: the king who sits on the throne of David: Zedekiah
decisions.reason: The king still reigning in Jerusalem was Zedekiah (verse 3), who had been put on the throne by Babylon in place of Jeconiah.

decisions.choice: for: the message about Jerusalem answers the exiles' hopes
decisions.reason: The exiles' prophets said that they would soon return (verses 8-9, 15). God's word about those left in Jerusalem shows why that cannot be: the city itself and its king are under judgment, so there will be no quick return to it.

decisions.choice: your brothers: your fellow countrymen, your own people
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means fellow members of the people of Judah, men and women, those who were not taken to Babylon in 597 BC.

decisions.choice: your brothers and sisters (gender setting)
decisions.reason: The word means all their kin who stayed behind, women as well as men, so Literal and Balanced give an inclusive default with "brothers" as the alternative. Readable says "relatives".

decisions.choice: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable names the city meant by "this city", since the exiles hearing the letter were in Babylon.

decisions.choice: sus hermanos
decisions.reason: Spanish "hermanos" already includes women, so no gender span is used where the English has one, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: ndugu zenu
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so Swahili needs no gender alternative here.

decisions.choice: "anh em" (L, B); "bà con" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Here "brothers" means fellow countrymen (meaning decision m4); Vietnamese "anh em" in this sense already includes women, as "bà con" does at Readable, so no gender setting is needed.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:형제자매|형제}}"
decisions.reason: "Your brothers" means your fellow countrymen (meaning decision m4); Korean uses the style guide's span for believers, with "형제" as the alternative, as the English does. Readable says "친척들", which needs no alternative.

decisions.choice: Verse 16 closed with "말씀하신다"
alternatives: the formula's colon running into verse 17
decisions.reason: Korean ends the formula as a sentence, as published (2 Kings 19:6); verse 17 repeats the formula, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ወንድሞቻችሁና እኅቶቻችሁ|ወንድሞቻችሁ}}
decisions.reason: Here Amharic has two real wordings, so the span follows the English one; Readable says "ዘመዶቻችሁ" (your relatives), which needs none.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}}
decisions.reason: The English offers "brothers and sisters / brothers" under the gender setting for one's fellow countrymen (m4). Hindi has the same choice, so Literal and Balanced keep the span, in the oblique form the Acts note settles (भाई-बहनों|भाइयों); Readable says रिश्तेदार, as the English says "relatives".

decisions.choice: acheikhem "あなたがたの{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}" (L, B), the style guide's gender span where the English L, B have one (fellow countrymen, m4); R "同胞" with no span, as the English R "relatives" has none.
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7 gender spans.

decisions.choice: R names "エルサレム" for ha'ir hazzot and adds "まだ", as the English R.
decisions.reason: As the English R.

source.text: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִי֙ מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ בָּ֔ם אֶת־הַחֶ֖רֶב אֶת־הָרָעָ֣ב וְאֶת־הַדָּ֑בֶר וְנָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֗ם כַּתְּאֵנִים֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: Behold, I [am] sending on them the sword, the famine and the pestilence, and I will make them like the figs the horrid which not can be eaten from badness.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: Look, I am sending against them the sword, the famine and the pestilence, and I will make them like horrid figs that cannot be eaten because of [their] badness.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: I am about to send the sword, famine and plague against them, and I will make them like rotten figs, so bad that they cannot be eaten.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: I am going to send war, famine and disease against them. I will make them like rotten figs that are too bad to eat.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: He aquí, yo envío contra ellos la espada, el hambre y la peste, y los pondré como los higos podridos que no se pueden comer de tan malos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Voy a enviar contra ellos la espada, el hambre y la peste, y los haré como higos podridos, tan malos que no se pueden comer.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Voy a enviar contra ellos la guerra, el hambre y las enfermedades. Los haré como higos podridos que no se pueden comer de tan malos.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Voici, j’envoie contre eux l’épée, la famine et la peste, et je les rendrai pareils à des figues infectes qu’on ne peut pas manger tant elles sont mauvaises.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Je vais envoyer contre eux l’épée, la famine et la peste, et je les rendrai pareils à des figues pourries, si mauvaises qu’on ne peut pas les manger.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Je vais envoyer contre eux la guerre, la famine et la maladie. Je les rendrai pareils à des figues pourries qui sont trop mauvaises pour qu’on les mange.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Tazama, ninatuma juu yao upanga, njaa na tauni, nami nitawafanya kama tini mbovu zisizoweza kuliwa kwa sababu ya ubaya [wake].
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Ninakaribia kutuma upanga, njaa na tauni dhidi yao, nami nitawafanya kama tini zilizooza, mbaya kiasi kwamba haziwezi kuliwa.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Nitatuma vita, njaa na magonjwa dhidi yao. Nitawafanya kama tini zilizooza ambazo ni mbaya mno kuliwa.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai gươm, nạn đói và ôn dịch đến hại chúng, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho chúng giống như những trái vả thối không thể ăn được vì quá xấu.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Ta sắp sai gươm đao, nạn đói và dịch bệnh đến hại chúng, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho chúng giống như những trái vả thối, xấu đến nỗi không ăn được.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Ta sắp sai chiến tranh, nạn đói và bệnh tật đến hại chúng. Ta sẽ làm cho chúng giống như những trái vả thối, xấu đến nỗi không ăn được.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보아라, 내가 그들에게 칼과 기근과 전염병을 보내어, 그들을 너무 나빠서 먹을 수 없는 썩은 무화과처럼 만들겠다.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 그들에게 칼과 기근과 전염병을 보내겠다. 내가 그들을 너무 나빠서 먹을 수 없는 썩은 무화과처럼 만들겠다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내가 그들에게 전쟁과 굶주림과 질병을 보내겠다. 내가 그들을 너무 썩어서 먹을 수 없는 무화과처럼 만들겠다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eis que eu envio contra eles a espada, a fome e a peste, e os farei como os figos podres que não se podem comer de tão ruins.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Estou para mandar contra eles a espada, a fome e a peste, e os farei como figos podres, tão ruins que não se podem comer.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: Vou mandar contra eles a guerra, a fome e a doença. Vou fazer deles como figos podres, que estão ruins demais para comer.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ፣ ሰይፍን፣ ራብንና ቸነፈርን እሰድባቸዋለሁ፤ ከመጥፎነታቸውም የተነሣ እንደማይበሉ እንደ ተበላሹ በለሶች አደርጋቸዋለሁ።
am.B: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ሰይፍ፣ ራብና ቸነፈር ልሰድባቸው ነው፤ ከመጥፎነታቸው የተነሣ እንደማይበሉ የበሰበሱ በለሶች አደርጋቸዋለሁ።
am.R: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ሰይፍ፣ ራብና ቸነፈር ልሰድባቸው ነው። ለመብላት እንኳ እንደማይሆኑ የበሰበሱ በለሶች አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

hi.L: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: देखो, मैं उन पर तलवार, अकाल और महामारी भेज रहा हूँ, और उन्हें ऐसे घिनौने अंजीरों के समान कर दूँगा जो बुरे होने के कारण खाए नहीं जा सकते।
hi.B: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: मैं उन पर तलवार, अकाल और महामारी भेजने पर हूँ, और उन्हें सड़े हुए अंजीरों के समान कर दूँगा, जो इतने बुरे हैं कि खाए नहीं जा सकते।
hi.R: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: मैं उन पर युद्ध, अकाल और बीमारी भेजने जा रहा हूँ। मैं उन्हें सड़े हुए अंजीरों जैसा कर दूँगा, जो इतने बुरे हैं कि खाए नहीं जा सकते।

ru.L: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посылаю на них меч, голод и мор и сделаю их подобными гадким смоквам, которые нельзя есть из-за [их] негодности.
ru.B: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Я пошлю на них меч, голод и мор и сделаю их подобными гнилым смоквам, такими плохими, что их нельзя есть.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств: Я пошлю на них войну, голод и болезни. Я сделаю их похожими на гнилой инжир, который такой плохой, что его нельзя есть.

ja.L: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。見なさい、わたしは彼らに剣と飢饉と疫病を送り、彼らを、悪さのゆえに食べられない、おぞましいいちじくのようにする。
ja.B: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは今、彼らに剣と飢饉と疫病を送ろうとしている。わたしは彼らを、悪くて食べられない、腐ったいちじくのようにする。
ja.R: 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、こう言われる。わたしは、彼らに戦争とききんと疫病を送る。わたしは彼らを、悪すぎて食べられない、腐ったいちじくのようにする。

uk.L: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посилаю на них меч, голод і моровицю, і зроблю їх, як гидкі смокви, яких не можна їсти через [їхню] поганість.
uk.B: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ: Я ось-ось пошлю на них меч, голод і пошесть, і зроблю їх подібними до гнилих смокв, таких поганих, що їх не можна їсти.
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель: Я пошлю на них війну, голод і хвороби. Я зроблю їх подібними до гнилих смокв, таких поганих, що їх неможливо їсти.

decisions.choice: thus says the LORD of hosts: the formula repeated
decisions.reason: Verse 16 began "thus says the LORD" and named those the message concerns; the formula is said again here before the message itself.

decisions.choice: like figs that cannot be eaten: the bad figs of chapter 24
decisions.reason: In the vision of the two baskets, the bad figs that could not be eaten stood for Zedekiah, his officials and those left in Jerusalem (24:2, 8). The letter applies that vision here, though it uses a different word for "bad".

decisions.choice: horrid: disgusting, rotten
decisions.reason: The word is found only here. It seems to be related to a word for something horrible or shocking (5:30; 23:14), and so means figs so spoiled that they disgust anyone who sees them.

decisions.choice: sword, famine and pestilence (Literal); sword, famine and plague (Balanced); war, famine and disease (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this triad throughout Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: rotten figs
decisions.reason: Literal says "horrid" for the rare word (m3); Balanced and Readable say "rotten", which is what such figs are.

decisions.choice: "меч, голод і моровиця" (L), "меч, голод і пошесть" (B), "війна, голод і хвороби" (R) for the triad, wherever it returns
decisions.reason: The book-wide triad of the Jeremiah terms note; "пошесть" names a deadly epidemic without fixing the disease as "чума" would.

decisions.choice: меч, голод и мор (L, B), война, голод и болезни (R); смоквы (L, B), инжир (R)
decisions.reason: The three disasters and the figs keep the wording of chapter 24 at each level.

decisions.choice: The triad "剣と飢饉と疫病" (L, B), "戦争とききんと疫病" (R), JER convention; te'enim hashsho'arim "おぞましいいちじく" (L), "腐ったいちじく" (B, R), echoing the bad figs of JER 24:2-3 ja ("悪くて食べられない") (m2, m3).
decisions.reason: JER-3 triad; JER-4 chapter 24 wording.

source.text: וְרָֽדַפְתִּי֙ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם בַּחֶ֖רֶב בָּרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וּנְתַתִּ֨ים לְזַעֲוָ֜ה לְכֹ֣ל׀מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֗רֶץ לְאָלָ֤ה וּלְשַׁמָּה֙ וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֣ה וּלְחֶרְפָּ֔ה בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־הִדַּחְתִּ֥ים שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine and with the pestilence, and I will make them for a horror to all [the] kingdoms of the earth, for a curse and for a desolation and for a hissing and for a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them there,

en.L: And I will pursue them with the sword, with famine and with pestilence, and I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, an execration and an appalling thing and a hissing and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,
en.B: I will pursue them with sword, famine and plague, and I will make them a horror to every kingdom on earth. Among all the nations where I have driven them, they will be a name used in curses, a thing that appalls, an object of scorn and a disgrace,
en.R: I will chase after them with war, famine and disease. All the kingdoms of the earth will be horrified at what happens to them. In all the nations where I scatter them, people will use their name as a curse. People will be shocked at them, mock them and insult them.

es.L: Y los perseguiré con la espada, con el hambre y con la peste, y los pondré por horror a todos los reinos de la tierra, por maldición, y por espanto, y por burla, y por oprobio entre todas las naciones adonde los he arrojado,
es.B: Los perseguiré con la espada, el hambre y la peste, y haré de ellos un horror para todos los reinos de la tierra. Entre todas las naciones adonde los he arrojado serán un nombre que se usa para maldecir, algo que espanta, un objeto de burla y una vergüenza,
es.R: Los perseguiré con la guerra, el hambre y las enfermedades. Todos los reinos de la tierra se horrorizarán por lo que les pasará. En todas las naciones adonde los disperse, la gente usará su nombre para maldecir. La gente se espantará al verlos, se burlará de ellos y los insultará.

fr.L: Et je les poursuivrai avec l’épée, avec la famine et avec la peste, et je ferai d’eux une horreur pour tous les royaumes de la terre, une exécration, un objet de stupeur, un objet de sifflements et un opprobre parmi toutes les nations où je les ai chassés,
fr.B: Je les poursuivrai par l’épée, la famine et la peste, et je ferai d’eux un objet d’horreur pour tous les royaumes de la terre. Parmi toutes les nations où je les ai chassés, ils seront un nom qu’on utilise pour maudire, un objet de stupeur, de moquerie et de honte,
fr.R: Je les poursuivrai par la guerre, la famine et la maladie. Tous les royaumes de la terre seront horrifiés de ce qui leur arrivera. Dans toutes les nations où je les disperserai, les gens se serviront de leur nom pour maudire. Les gens seront choqués en les voyant, se moqueront d’eux et les insulteront.

sw.L: Nami nitawafuatia kwa upanga, kwa njaa na kwa tauni, nami nitawafanya kuwa kitisho kwa falme zote za dunia, kiapo cha laana, na kitu cha kushangaza, na [kitu cha] kuzomewa, na aibu kati ya mataifa yote nilikowafukuzia,
sw.B: Nitawafuatia kwa upanga, njaa na tauni, nami nitawafanya kuwa kitisho kwa kila ufalme duniani. Kati ya mataifa yote nilikowafukuzia, watakuwa jina linalotumiwa katika laana, kitu cha kushangaza, kitu cha kudharauliwa na aibu,
sw.R: Nitawafukuza kwa vita, njaa na magonjwa. Falme zote za dunia zitaogopa kwa yale yatakayowapata. Katika mataifa yote nitakakowatawanya, watu watalitumia jina lao kama laana. Watu watashtuka wakiwaona, watawadhihaki na kuwatukana.

vi.L: Ta sẽ đuổi theo chúng bằng gươm, nạn đói và ôn dịch, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho chúng thành một điều kinh hoàng cho mọi vương quốc trên đất, một sự rủa sả, một điều kinh khiếp, một tiếng huýt sáo và một sự sỉ nhục giữa mọi dân tộc mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi chúng đến,
vi.B: Ta sẽ đuổi theo chúng bằng gươm đao, nạn đói và dịch bệnh, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho chúng thành một điều kinh hoàng cho mọi vương quốc trên đất. Giữa mọi dân tộc mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi chúng đến, chúng sẽ thành một lời nguyền rủa, một điều kinh khiếp, một mối nhạo báng và một sự sỉ nhục,
vi.R: Ta sẽ đuổi theo chúng bằng chiến tranh, nạn đói và bệnh tật. Mọi vương quốc trên đất sẽ kinh hoàng khi thấy điều xảy đến cho chúng. Tại mọi nước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho chúng tan lạc đến, người ta sẽ dùng tên chúng để nguyền rủa. Người ta sẽ sửng sốt về chúng, chế giễu và sỉ nhục chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 칼과 기근과 전염병으로 그들을 뒤쫓아, 그들을 땅의 모든 나라에 공포가 되게 하고, 내가 그들을 쫓아낸 모든 민족 가운데서 저주의 맹세거리와 놀람과 휘파람거리와 치욕이 되게 하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 칼과 기근과 전염병으로 그들을 뒤쫓아, 세상 모든 나라에 공포의 대상이 되게 하겠다. 내가 그들을 쫓아 보낸 모든 민족 가운데서 그들은 사람들이 저주할 때 들먹이는 이름, 놀라움의 대상, 비웃음거리, 수치가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 전쟁과 굶주림과 질병으로 그들을 뒤쫓겠다. 세상 모든 나라가 그들에게 일어난 일을 보고 몸서리칠 것이다. 내가 그들을 흩어 보내는 모든 나라에서 사람들은 저주할 때에 그들의 이름을 쓸 것이다. 사람들은 그들을 보고 놀라고 비웃고 모욕할 것이다.

pt.L: E os perseguirei com a espada, com a fome e com a peste, e farei deles um horror para todos os reinos da terra, uma execração, e um espanto, e um assobio, e uma afronta entre todas as nações para onde os expulsei,
pt.B: Eu os perseguirei com a espada, a fome e a peste, e farei deles um objeto de horror para todos os reinos da terra. Entre todas as nações para onde os expulsei, eles serão um nome usado em maldições, um espanto, um objeto de zombaria e uma vergonha,
pt.R: Vou persegui-los com a guerra, a fome e a doença. Todos os reinos da terra vão ficar horrorizados com o que vai acontecer com eles. Em todas as nações para onde eu os espalhar, as pessoas vão usar o nome deles para amaldiçoar. As pessoas vão ficar chocadas com eles, vão zombar deles e insultá-los.

am.L: በሰይፍ፣ በራብና በቸነፈር አሳድዳቸዋለሁ፤ ለምድርም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ድንጋጤ፣ ባሳደድኋቸውም በሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል እርግማንና መደነቂያ፣ ማፏጫና ስድብ አደርጋቸዋለሁ፤
am.B: በሰይፍ፣ በራብና በቸነፈር አሳድዳቸዋለሁ፤ ለምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉም ድንጋጤ አደርጋቸዋለሁ። ባሳደድኋቸው ሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል መራገሚያ፣ የሚያስደነግጥ ነገር፣ መዘባበቻና መሰደቢያ ይሆናሉ፤
am.R: በሰይፍ፣ በራብና በቸነፈር አሳድዳቸዋለሁ። የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ በእነርሱ ላይ በሚደርሰው ነገር ይደነግጣሉ። በምበትናቸው ሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል ሰዎች ሲራገሙ ስማቸውን ይጠራሉ። ሰዎች በእነርሱ ይደነግጣሉ፤ ይሳለቁባቸዋል፤ ይሰድቧቸዋልም።

hi.L: और मैं तलवार से, अकाल से और महामारी से उनका पीछा करूँगा, और उन्हें पृथ्वी के सब राज्यों के लिए भय का कारण, और उन सब जातियों के बीच जिनमें मैंने उन्हें भगा दिया है, शाप और विस्मय और सीटी और निंदा का विषय बना दूँगा,
hi.B: मैं तलवार, अकाल और महामारी से उनका पीछा करूँगा, और उन्हें पृथ्वी के हर राज्य के लिए भय का कारण बना दूँगा। जिन जिन देशों में मैंने उन्हें भगा दिया है, उनके बीच वे शाप का नाम, विस्मय की वस्तु, उपहास का विषय और अपमान बनेंगे,
hi.R: मैं युद्ध, अकाल और बीमारी लेकर उनका पीछा करूँगा। पृथ्वी के सब राज्य उन पर जो बीतेगा उसे देखकर काँप उठेंगे। जिन जिन देशों में मैं उन्हें तितर-बितर करूँगा, वहाँ लोग शाप देते समय उनका नाम लेंगे। लोग उन्हें देखकर चौंक उठेंगे, उनका मज़ाक़ उड़ाएँगे और उनका अपमान करेंगे।

ru.L: И буду преследовать их мечом, голодом и мором, и сделаю их ужасом для всех царств земли, проклятием, и предметом изумления, и посмеянием, и позором среди всех народов, куда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изгнал их,
ru.B: Я буду преследовать их мечом, голодом и мором и сделаю их ужасом для всех царств земли. Среди всех народов, куда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изгнал их, их имя станет проклятием, предметом изумления, предметом насмешек и позором,
ru.R: Я буду гнаться за ними с войной, голодом и болезнями. Все царства земли будут в ужасе от того, что с ними случится. Во всех народах, куда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} их рассею, люди будут произносить их имя, когда проклинают. Люди будут ужасаться им, смеяться над ними и оскорблять их.

ja.L: わたしは剣と飢饉と疫病で彼らを追い、彼らを地のすべての王国にとって恐怖とし、わたしが彼らを追いやったすべての国々の中で、呪いとし、驚きとし、あざけりの口笛とし、そしりとする。
ja.B: わたしは剣と飢饉と疫病で彼らを追い詰め、彼らを地のすべての王国の恐怖の的とする。わたしが彼らを追いやったすべての国々の中で、彼らは呪いの言葉となり、人々を驚かせ、あざけりの的となり、恥となる。
ja.R: わたしは、戦争とききんと疫病で、彼らを追いかける。世界中の国々は、彼らに起こることを見て震え上がる。わたしが彼らを散らすすべての国々で、人々はのろいの言葉に彼らの名を使う。人々は彼らを見て驚き、あざけり、ののしる。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} переслідуватиму їх мечем, голодом і моровицею, і зроблю їх жахом для всіх царств землі, закляттям, і страховищем, і посвистом, і ганьбою серед усіх народів, куди {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вигнав їх,
uk.B: Я переслідуватиму їх мечем, голодом і пошестю і зроблю їх жахом для всіх царств землі. Серед усіх народів, куди {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} їх вигнав, вони стануть імʼям, яким проклинають, тим, що жахає, предметом глуму й ганьбою,
uk.R: Я гнатимуся за ними з війною, голодом і хворобами. Усі царства землі жахатимуться того, що з ними станеться. В усіх народах, куди {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} їх розсію, люди проклинатимуть їхнім імʼям. Люди будуть приголомшені ними, глузуватимуть з них і ганьбитимуть їх,

decisions.choice: horror: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: As in 24:9, the written consonants (ketiv) put two letters of this word in a different order; the scribes marked the usual form to be read aloud (qere). Both name the same word.

decisions.choice: a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, a curse and a reproach: the covenant warnings fulfilled
decisions.reason: Moses warned that Israel would become a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth (Deuteronomy 28:25) and a byword among the nations (Deuteronomy 28:37). Jeremiah repeats the words in 15:4, 24:9 and 34:17.

decisions.choice: an appalling thing: a desolation that stuns those who see it
decisions.reason: The word means both a ruin and the shock it causes, as in 19:8. Those who see what has happened to them will be appalled.

decisions.choice: a hissing: the sound people made at a sight of ruin, in shock and scorn
decisions.reason: Passers-by hissed or whistled at a ruined place or people, a gesture of horror and of mockery (18:16; 19:8; Lamentations 2:15).

decisions.choice: horror; an execration (Balanced: a name used in curses); an appalling thing (Balanced: a thing that appalls); hissing (Balanced: object of scorn); reproach (Balanced: disgrace); Readable in sentences
decisions.reason: The curse word follows the wording set for these lists (42:18; 44:12). "Horror" is kept for the first word, as in 24:9, so the third word, which 19:8 calls a horror, is here "an appalling thing". The hissing follows the book's wording (19:8). Readable says what each word means in sentences of its own.

decisions.choice: two sentences; the nations first in the second
decisions.reason: Balanced divides the verse into two sentences and ends with a comma, since verse 19 gives the reason. Readable uses short sentences and says "scatter" for "drive".

decisions.choice: kiapo cha laana (Literal); jina linalotumiwa katika laana (Balanced); laana (Readable)
decisions.reason: *'Alah* in the curse lists, at each level as the English note sets ("an execration" / "a name used in curses" / "a curse"), worded as in 42:18 and 44:12.

decisions.choice: "une exécration" (L); "un nom qu'on utilise pour maudire" (B); "se serviront de leur nom pour maudire" (R)
decisions.reason: 'Alah in the curse lists as the Jeremiah note sets it; "objet de sifflements / de moquerie" as for shereqah elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "sự rủa sả" (L), "lời nguyền rủa" (B) for alah; "tiếng huýt sáo" / "mối nhạo báng" for shereqah
decisions.reason: The words settled for these lists in 18:16 and 24:9, so the same curse words return here at each level.

decisions.choice: "공포 ... 저주의 맹세거리 ... 놀람 ... 휘파람거리 ... 치욕" (L); "공포의 대상 ... 사람들이 저주할 때 들먹이는 이름 ... 비웃음거리 ... 수치" (B)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for Jeremiah's lists of curses (24:9; 25:18; 42:18; 44:12): *ʾalah* is "저주의 맹세거리" / "사람들이 저주할 때 들먹이는 이름", *qelalah* "저주" / "저주거리".

decisions.choice: The list as 24:9 and 25:18: "ድንጋጤ", "እርግማን" / "መራገሚያ", "ማፏጫ" / "መዘባበቻ", "ስድብ" / "መሰደቢያ"; an appalling thing "መደነቂያ"
decisions.reason: The same Amharic for each repeated Hebrew word of the covenant curses.

decisions.choice: The curse lists: "жах ... посвист ... ганьба" (L), "жах ... предмет глуму ... ганьба" (B), "глузуватимуть" (R); the execration "закляття" (L), "імʼя, яким проклинають" (B), "проклинатимуть" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording per level wherever these lists return, following the Jeremiah terms note; Literal keeps the hissing, the gesture of scorn, as "посвист".

decisions.choice: भय का कारण; शाप; विस्मय; सीटी (L) / उपहास (B); निंदा (L) / अपमान (B)
decisions.reason: The covenant curses keep the words used at 24:9 and 25:9, 18, with भय का कारण for the horror as Deuteronomy 28:25, with विस्मय for the appalling thing (shammah), as 2 Chronicles 29:8 has it.

decisions.choice: проклятие, предмет изумления, посмеяние (L), предмет насмешек (B), позор
decisions.reason: The list keeps the wording set in 24:9 and 25:18; "предмет изумления" is the appalled stare, as 2 Chronicles 29:8 has it.

decisions.choice: za'avah "恐怖" (L), "恐怖の的" (B), R as JER 15:4 / 24:9 ja ("震え上がる"); 'alah "呪い" (L), "呪いの言葉" (B), "のろいの言葉" (R); shammah "驚き" (L), sheriqah "あざけりの口笛" (L), "あざけりの的" (B), cherpah "そしり" (L), "恥" (B) (m3, m4); R in sentences as the English R.
decisions.reason: JER-3 (shammah / sheriqah), 2CH 29:8 (恐怖・驚き・あざけりの口笛), 24:9 ja (そしり).

source.text: תַּ֛חַת אֲשֶֽׁר־לֹא־שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶל־דְּבָרַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־עֲבָדַ֤י הַנְּבִאִים֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְשָׁלֹ֔חַ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: because that not they listened to my words, declaration of Yahweh, which I sent to them [by] my servants the prophets, rising early and sending, and not you listened, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: because they did not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which I sent to them by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets, rising early and sending; and you did not listen, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: because they have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the words I sent them through {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets, again and again. And you did not listen either, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: This is because they would not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Over and over I sent {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets to them with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} message. And you exiles did not listen either, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: por cuanto no escucharon {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que les envié por medio de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas, madrugando y enviando; y no {{plural_you:escucharon|escuchasteis}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
