es.B: porque no han escuchado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, las palabras que les envié una y otra vez por medio de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas. Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tampoco {{plural_you:escucharon|escuchasteis}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Esto es porque no quisieron escuchar {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Una y otra vez les envié a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensaje. Y {{plural_you:ustedes, los desterrados, tampoco escucharon|vosotros, los desterrados, tampoco escuchasteis}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: parce qu’ils n’ont pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que je leur ai envoyées par {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} levant de bonne heure et [les] envoyant ; et vous n’avez pas écouté, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: parce qu’ils n’ont pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les paroles que je leur ai envoyées sans relâche par {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes. Et vous non plus, vous n’avez pas écouté, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Cela arrivera parce qu’ils n’ont pas voulu écouter {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Encore et encore, je leur ai envoyé {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes avec {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} message. Et vous, les exilés, vous n’avez pas écouté non plus, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: kwa sababu hawakuyasikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, niliyowapelekea kwa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii, nikiamka mapema na kuwatuma; nanyi hamkusikiliza, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: kwa sababu hawakuyasikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, maneno niliyowapelekea kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii tena na tena. Nanyi pia hamkusikiliza, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Hii ni kwa sababu hawakutaka kusikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mara nyingi sana niliwatuma watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii kwao na ujumbe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nanyi mliohamishwa hamkusikiliza pia, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: vì chúng đã không nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, là lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri đem đến cho chúng, dậy sớm mà sai đến; còn các ngươi cũng không nghe, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: vì chúng đã không nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, là lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri đem đến cho chúng hết lần này đến lần khác. Còn các ngươi cũng chẳng nghe, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Việc ấy xảy ra vì chúng không chịu nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta đã nhiều lần sai các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri đem sứ điệp của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến cho chúng. Còn các ngươi, những người lưu đày, cũng không chịu nghe, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그들이 내 말을 듣지 않았기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 내 종 예언자들을 통해 일찍 일어나 보내며 그들에게 그 말을 보냈으나, 너희가 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그들이 내 말을 듣지 않았기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 내 종 예언자들을 통해 그 말을 거듭거듭 보냈다. 그런데 너희도 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 이것은 그들이 내 말을 들으려 하지 않았기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 몇 번이고 내 종 예언자들을 그들에게 보내어 내 말을 전했다. 그런데 포로로 끌려간 너희도 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: porque não ouviram as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que lhes enviei pelos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos, os profetas, madrugando e enviando; e vocês não ouviram, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: porque eles não ouviram as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, as palavras que lhes enviei por meio dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos, os profetas, repetidas vezes. E vocês também não ouviram, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Isso vai acontecer porque eles não quiseram ouvir as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Muitas e muitas vezes enviei a eles os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} servos, os profetas, com a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mensagem. E vocês, os exilados, também não ouviram, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ማልጄ እየላክኋቸው በእነርሱ የላክኩላቸውን ቃሌን አልሰሙምና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ እናንተም አልሰማችሁም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: በአገልጋዮቼ በነቢያት ደጋግሜ የላክኩላቸውን ቃሌን አልሰሙምና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። እናንተም ደግሞ አልሰማችሁም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ይህ የሚሆነው ቃሌን ስላልሰሙ ነው፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። አገልጋዮቼን ነቢያትን መልእክቴን ይዘው ደጋግሜ ወደ እነርሱ ላክኋቸው። እናንተ ምርኮኞችም አልሰማችሁም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: क्योंकि उन्होंने मेरे वचन नहीं सुने, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, जो मैंने अपने दासों, भविष्यद्वक्ताओं के द्वारा तड़के उठ उठकर उनके पास भेजे; और तुमने भी नहीं सुना, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: क्योंकि उन्होंने मेरे वचन नहीं सुने, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, वे वचन जो मैंने अपने दासों, भविष्यद्वक्ताओं के द्वारा बार-बार उनके पास भेजे। और तुमने भी नहीं सुना, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: यह इसलिए होगा क्योंकि उन्होंने मेरे वचन सुनने से इनकार किया, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। मैंने बार-बार अपने दासों, अपने नबियों को अपना संदेश देकर उनके पास भेजा। और तुम बंधुओं ने भी नहीं सुना, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: за то, что они не слушали {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} слов, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — которые {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посылал им через {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} рабов, пророков, вставая рано и посылая; и вы не слушали, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: за то, что они не слушали {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} слов, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — слов, которые {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} снова и снова посылал им через {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} рабов, пророков. И вы тоже не слушали, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Это за то, что они не хотели слушать {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} слов, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Я снова и снова посылал к ним {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} рабов, пророков с {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} вестью. И вы, пленники, тоже не слушали, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 彼らがわたしの言葉に聞き従わなかったからだ――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。わたしは、わたしのしもべである預言者たちによって、朝早くから彼らに[言葉を]送り続けたのに。あなたがたも聞き従わなかった――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。
ja.B: 彼らがわたしの言葉に聞き従わなかったからだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。わたしは、わたしのしもべである預言者たちを通して、繰り返しその言葉を彼らに送った。あなたがたも聞き従わなかった、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: それは、彼らがわたしの言葉を聞こうとしなかったからだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。わたしは、何度も何度も、わたしのしもべである預言者たちを彼らに遣わし、わたしの言葉を伝えた。捕虜となったあなたたちも、聞こうとしなかった、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: за те, що вони не слухали {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} слів, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, які {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посилав до них через {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} рабів пророків, рано встаючи і посилаючи; і ви не слухали, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: за те, що вони не слухали {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} слів, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, тих слів, які {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знову і знову посилав їм через {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} рабів пророків. І ви теж не слухали, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Це тому, що вони не хотіли слухати {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} слів, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Раз по раз {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посилав до них {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} рабів пророків з {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} посланням. І ви, вигнанці, теж не слухали, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: rising early and sending: sending again and again, without giving up
decisions.reason: As in 7:13 and 7:25, the phrase pictures someone who starts work early each day and keeps at it.

decisions.choice: my servants the prophets: those who served God by bringing his word
decisions.reason: As in 7:25, the title honors the prophets as God's messengers (25:4; 26:5; 35:15).

decisions.choice: and you did not listen: the exiles too
decisions.reason: The verse speaks first of those in Jerusalem ("they") and then turns to the exiles hearing the letter ("you"). The exiles had not listened either, which is why they too had been sent away; now they must not repeat that by trusting their prophets (verses 8-9, 20).

decisions.choice: rising early and sending (Literal); again and again (Balanced); over and over (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this phrase throughout Jeremiah. "Servants" is kept at every level for the prophets, as in 7:25.

decisions.choice: you exiles; with my message
decisions.reason: Readable says who "you" are (m3) and what the prophets brought.

decisions.choice: 'avadai hannevi'im "わたしのしもべである預言者たち" (every level); hashkem veshaloach "朝早くから……送り続けた" (L), "繰り返し……送った" (B), "何度も何度も……遣わし" (R), the JER-2 forms (m1).
decisions.reason: JER-2 formulas (7:13, 7:25).

decisions.choice: "рано встаючи і посилаючи" (L), "знову і знову" (B), "раз по раз" (R), wherever the idiom returns
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording of the Jeremiah terms note: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, the other levels its sense of persistence.

source.text: וְאַתֶּ֖ם שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־יְהוָ֑ה כָּל־הַ֨גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you, hear [the] word of Yahweh, all the exile whom I sent from Jerusalem to Babylon.

en.L: And you, hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the exiles whom I sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
en.B: But you, all you exiles whom I sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon, hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So now, all of you captives whom I sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon, listen to the message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, todos los del destierro que envié de Jerusalén a Babilonia.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, todos los desterrados que envié de Jerusalén a Babilonia, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Así que ahora, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los prisioneros que envié de Jerusalén a Babilonia, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et vous, écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous tous, exilés que j’ai envoyés de Jérusalem à Babylone.
fr.B: Mais vous, tous les exilés que j’ai envoyés de Jérusalem à Babylone, écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors maintenant, vous tous, les prisonniers que j’ai envoyés de Jérusalem à Babylone, écoutez le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nanyi, sikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi mateka wote niliowatuma kutoka Yerusalemu mpaka Babeli.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi, ninyi mateka wote niliowatoa Yerusalemu kuwapeleka Babeli, sikilizeni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Basi sasa, ninyi nyote mliochukuliwa mateka, niliowatoa Yerusalemu kuwapeleka Babeli, sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Còn các ngươi, hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi mọi người lưu đày mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai đi từ Giê-ru-sa-lem qua Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Nhưng các ngươi, hỡi mọi người lưu đày mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai đi từ Giê-ru-sa-lem qua Ba-by-lôn, hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, hỡi tất cả những người bị bắt làm tù binh mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đưa từ Giê-ru-sa-lem qua Ba-by-lôn, hãy nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그러니 너희, 내가 예루살렘에서 바빌론으로 보낸 모든 포로는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라.
ko.B: 그러니 내가 예루살렘에서 바빌론으로 보낸 너희 모든 포로는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라.
ko.R: 그러니 내가 예루살렘에서 바빌론으로 보낸 너희 포로들은 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라.

pt.L: E vocês, ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, todos os exilados que enviei de Jerusalém para a Babilônia.
pt.B: Mas vocês, todos os exilados que enviei de Jerusalém para a Babilônia, ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Agora, então, todos vocês, prisioneiros que mandei de Jerusalém para a Babilônia, escutem a mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: እናንተ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን የሰደድኋችሁ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል ስሙ።
am.B: እናንተ ግን ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን የሰደድኋችሁ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል ስሙ።
am.R: ስለዚህ አሁን እናንተ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን የሰደድኋችሁ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} የመጣውን መልእክት ስሙ።

hi.L: और तुम, हे सब बंधुओ, जिन्हें मैंने यरूशलेम से बाबुल भेज दिया है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन सुनो।
hi.B: पर तुम, हे सब बंधुओ, जिन्हें मैंने यरूशलेम से बाबुल भेज दिया है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन सुनो।
hi.R: इसलिए अब, हे सब बंदियो, जिन्हें मैंने यरूशलेम से बाबुल भेज दिया है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का संदेश सुनो।

ru.L: А вы слушайте слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, все изгнанники, которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отослал из Иерусалима в Вавилон.
ru.B: А вы, все изгнанники, которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отослал из Иерусалима в Вавилон, слушайте слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Итак, все вы, пленники, которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отослал из Иерусалима в Вавилон, слушайте весть от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: それで、あなたがた、わたしがエルサレムからバビロンへ送り出したすべての捕囚の民よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉を聞け。
ja.B: だから、わたしがエルサレムからバビロンへ送り出した捕囚の民よ、あなたがたは皆、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉を聞きなさい。
ja.R: だから、わたしがエルサレムからバビロンへ送り出した、捕虜となった人々よ、みな、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のお告げを聞きなさい。

uk.L: А ви слухайте слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, всі вигнанці, яких {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відіслав з Єрусалима до Вавилону.
uk.B: А ви, всі вигнанці, яких {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відіслав з Єрусалима до Вавилону, слухайте слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Тож тепер усі ви, полонені, яких {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відіслав з Єрусалима до Вавилону, послухайте послання від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: and you: an emphatic turn to the exiles
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out: "as for you". Unlike those who would not listen (verse 19), the exiles are called to hear now; the word they are to hear follows in verses 21-23.

decisions.choice: whom I sent away: a gentler word than "exiled"
decisions.reason: The verb means to send off or let go. It is used of the exiles in 24:5, and it again makes God the one who sent them.

decisions.choice: the address first, then the command
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the long address before "hear", as English does. Readable says "So now" to mark the turn.

decisions.choice: shim'u devar YHWH "{D}の言葉を聞け" (L), "…を聞きなさい" (B), "{D}のお告げを聞きなさい" (R), the JER formula; shillachti "送り出した" (every level), a gentler word than "捕らえ移した" (m2).
decisions.reason: JER-1 formulas.

source.text: כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־אַחְאָ֤ב בֶּן־קֽוֹלָיָה֙ וְאֶל־צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־מַֽעֲשֵׂיָ֔ה הַֽנִּבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶ֛ם בִּשְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑קֶר הִנְנִ֣י׀נֹתֵ֣ן אֹתָ֗ם בְּיַד֙ נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וְהִכָּ֖ם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel, concerning Ahab son of Kolaiah and concerning Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, the [ones] prophesying to you in my name falsehood: Behold, I [am] giving them into [the] hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he will strike them before your eyes.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab son of Kolaiah and concerning Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying a lie to you in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name: Look, I am giving them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he will strike them down before your eyes.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this about Ahab son of Kolaiah and about Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying lies to you in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name: I am about to hand them over to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he will put them to death before your eyes.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and about Zedekiah son of Maaseiah. They are using {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name to tell you lies. I am going to hand them over to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he will kill them while you watch.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, acerca de Acab hijo de Colaías y acerca de Sedequías hijo de Maasías, que {{plural_you:les|os}} profetizan mentira en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre: He aquí, yo los entrego en mano de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, y él los herirá delante de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto acerca de Acab hijo de Colaías y acerca de Sedequías hijo de Maasías, que {{plural_you:les|os}} profetizan mentiras en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre: Voy a entregarlos en manos de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, y él los matará delante de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, acerca de Acab hijo de Colaías y acerca de Sedequías hijo de Maasías. Ellos están usando {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para {{plural_you:decirles|deciros}} mentiras. Voy a entregarlos a Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, y él los matará mientras {{plural_you:ustedes miran|vosotros miráis}}.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, au sujet d’Achab fils de Qolaya et au sujet de Sédécias fils de Maaséya, qui vous prophétisent le mensonge en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom : Voici, je les livre entre les mains de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, et il les frappera sous vos yeux.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci au sujet d’Achab fils de Qolaya et de Sédécias fils de Maaséya, qui vous prophétisent des mensonges en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom : Je vais les livrer à Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, et il les mettra à mort sous vos yeux.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, au sujet d’Achab, fils de Qolaya, et de Sédécias, fils de Maaséya. Ils se servent de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour vous dire des mensonges. Je vais les livrer à Nabuchodonosor, le roi de Babylone, et il les tuera sous vos yeux.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi kuhusu Ahabu mwana wa Kolaya, na kuhusu Sedekia mwana wa Maaseya, wanaowatabiria uongo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}: Tazama, nitawatia mkononi mwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, naye atawapiga mbele ya macho yenu.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo kuhusu Ahabu mwana wa Kolaya na Sedekia mwana wa Maaseya, wanaowatabiria uongo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}: Ninakaribia kuwatia mikononi mwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, naye atawaua mbele ya macho yenu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema kuhusu Ahabu mwana wa Kolaya na Sedekia mwana wa Maaseya. Wanalitumia jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kuwaambia uongo. Nitawatia mikononi mwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, naye atawaua mkiwa mnatazama.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này về A-háp con trai Cô-la-gia và về Sê-đê-kia con trai Ma-a-sê-gia, là những kẻ nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói tiên tri giả dối cho các ngươi: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phó chúng vào tay Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, và vua ấy sẽ giết chúng trước mắt các ngươi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy về A-háp con trai Cô-la-gia và Sê-đê-kia con trai Ma-a-sê-gia, là những kẻ nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà nói tiên tri dối trá cho các ngươi: Ta sắp phó chúng vào tay Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, và vua ấy sẽ xử tử chúng trước mắt các ngươi.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán về A-háp con trai Cô-la-gia và Sê-đê-kia con trai Ma-a-sê-gia. Chúng dùng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để nói dối với các ngươi. Ta sắp phó chúng vào tay Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, và vua ấy sẽ giết chúng ngay trước mắt các ngươi.

ko.L: 이스라엘의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 이름으로 너희에게 거짓을 예언하는 골라야의 아들 아합과 마아세야의 아들 시드기야에 대하여 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보아라, 내가 그들을 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살의 손에 넘겨주겠다. 그가 너희 눈앞에서 그들을 쳐 죽일 것이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 이름으로 너희에게 거짓을 예언하는 골라야의 아들 아합과 마아세야의 아들 시드기야에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 그들을 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살에게 넘겨주겠다. 그는 너희가 보는 앞에서 그들을 처형할 것이다.
ko.R: 이스라엘의 하나님, 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 골라야의 아들 아합과 마아세야의 아들 시드기야에 대하여 하시는 말씀이다. 그들은 내 이름을 팔아 너희에게 거짓말을 하고 있다. 내가 그들을 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살에게 넘겨주겠다. 그는 너희가 보는 앞에서 그들을 죽일 것이다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, a respeito de Acabe, filho de Colaías, e a respeito de Zedequias, filho de Maaseias, que lhes profetizam mentira em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome: Eis que os entrego na mão de Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, e ele os ferirá diante dos olhos de vocês.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, a respeito de Acabe, filho de Colaías, e de Zedequias, filho de Maaseias, que profetizam mentiras a vocês em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome: Estou para entregá-los a Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, e ele os matará diante dos olhos de vocês.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, diz a respeito de Acabe, filho de Colaías, e de Zedequias, filho de Maaseias. Eles estão usando o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome para contar mentiras a vocês. Vou entregá-los a Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, e ele vai matá-los enquanto vocês olham.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ በስሜ ሐሰትን ትንቢት ስለሚናገሩላችሁ ስለ ቆላያ ልጅ ስለ አክዓብና ስለ ማዕሴያ ልጅ ስለ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ፣ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ እርሱም በዓይናችሁ ፊት ይገድላቸዋል።
am.B: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ በስሜ የሐሰት ትንቢት ስለሚናገሩላችሁ ስለ ቆላያ ልጅ ስለ አክዓብና ስለ ማዕሴያ ልጅ ስለ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል፦ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር አሳልፌ ልሰጣቸው ነው፤ እርሱም በዓይናችሁ ፊት ይገድላቸዋል።
am.R: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ ስለ ቆላያ ልጅ ስለ አክዓብና ስለ ማዕሴያ ልጅ ስለ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል። እነርሱ ስሜን እየጠሩ ውሸት ይነግሯችኋል። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር አሳልፌ ልሰጣቸው ነው፤ እርሱም እናንተ እያያችሁ ይገድላቸዋል።

hi.L: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, कोलायाह के पुत्र अहाब के विषय में और मासेयाह के पुत्र सिदकिय्याह के विषय में, जो मेरे नाम से तुमसे झूठी भविष्यवाणी करते हैं, यों कहते हैं: देखो, मैं उन्हें बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर के हाथ में देने पर हूँ, और वह तुम्हारी आँखों के सामने उन्हें मार डालेगा।
hi.B: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, कोलायाह के पुत्र अहाब के विषय में और मासेयाह के पुत्र सिदकिय्याह के विषय में, जो मेरे नाम से तुमसे झूठी भविष्यवाणी कर रहे हैं, यह कहते हैं: मैं उन्हें बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर के हवाले करने पर हूँ, और वह तुम्हारी आँखों के सामने उन्हें मरवा डालेगा।
hi.R: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, कोलायाह के बेटे अहाब के बारे में और मासेयाह के बेटे सिदकिय्याह के बारे में यह कहते हैं। वे मेरा नाम लेकर तुमसे झूठ बोल रहे हैं। मैं उन्हें बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर के हवाले करने जा रहा हूँ, और तुम्हारे देखते-देखते वह उन्हें मार डालेगा।

ru.L: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля, об Ахаве, сыне Колаии, и о Седекии, сыне Маасеи, пророчествующих вам {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем ложь: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отдаю их в руку Навуходорносора, царя Вавилона, и он поразит их на ваших глазах.
ru.B: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля, об Ахаве, сыне Колаии, и о Седекии, сыне Маасеи, которые пророчествуют вам ложь {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем: Я отдам их в руки Навуходорносора, царя Вавилона, и он казнит их у вас на глазах.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, Бог Израиля, об Ахаве, сыне Колаии, и о Седекии, сыне Маасеи. Они прикрываются {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем и говорят вам ложь. Я отдам их Навуходорносору, царю Вавилона, и он убьёт их, а вы будете смотреть.

ja.L: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神は、わたしの名によってあなたがたに偽りを預言している、コラヤの子アハブとマアセヤの子ツィドキヤについて、こう言われる。見なさい、わたしは彼らをバビロンの王ネブカドネツァルの手に渡す。彼はあなたがたの目の前で彼らを打ち殺す。
ja.B: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神は、わたしの名によってあなたがたに偽りを預言している、コラヤの子アハブとマアセヤの子ツィドキヤについて、こう言われる。わたしは今、彼らをバビロンの王ネブカドネツァルに引き渡す。王は、あなたがたの目の前で彼らを殺す。
ja.R: 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神は、コラヤの息子アハブと、マアセヤの息子ツィドキヤについて、こう言われる。この二人は、わたしの名を使って、あなたたちにうそを語っている。わたしは、彼らをバビロンの王ネブカドネツァルに引き渡す。王は、あなたたちの見ている前で、彼らを殺す。

uk.L: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, Бог Ізраїлю, про Ахава, сина Колаї, і про Седекію, сина Маасеї, які пророкують вам неправду {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} віддаю їх у руку Навуходоносора, царя Вавилону, і він уразить їх на ваших очах.
uk.B: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, Бог Ізраїлю, про Ахава, сина Колаї, і про Седекію, сина Маасеї, які пророкують вам неправду {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям: Я ось-ось віддам їх Навуходоносорові, цареві Вавилону, і він стратить їх на ваших очах.
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, Бог Ізраїлю, про Ахава, сина Колаї, і про Седекію, сина Маасеї. Вони прикриваються {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям, щоб говорити вам брехню. Я віддам їх Навуходоносорові, цареві Вавилону, і він убʼє їх у вас на очах.

decisions.choice: Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah: two prophets among the exiles
decisions.reason: These two men are known only from this passage. This Zedekiah is not the king of verse 3; the name was common. They were among the prophets in Babylon of verse 15.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadrezzar: the form of the name with r
decisions.reason: Verses 1 and 3 spell the king's name Nebuchadnezzar; this verse has the form Nebuchadrezzar used in most of Jeremiah (see 25:1). It is the same king.

decisions.choice: giving them into the hand of: handing them over to the power of
decisions.reason: To give someone into another's hand is to put that person in the other's power, here for punishment (21:7; 22:25).

decisions.choice: he will strike them: he will put them to death
decisions.reason: The verb means to strike, and often to kill. Verse 22 says how they died. The text does not say why the king of Babylon would execute them; prophets who promised a quick end to Babylon's rule (verses 8-9; 28:2-4) could well be seen as stirring up revolt. Verse 23 gives God's reason.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadrezzar
decisions.reason: Each verse keeps the form of the name its Hebrew uses (m2).

decisions.choice: hand them over; put them to death (Balanced); kill them while you watch (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idioms mean in plain English (m3, m4).

decisions.choice: Nabucodorosor
decisions.reason: Within this letter the Hebrew switches from the -n- form (verses 1 and 3) to the -r- form here; each verse keeps the form its Hebrew has, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Nebukadreza
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew spells the name with r again, so Swahili follows it, as in 21-25; the false prophet Sedekia mwana wa Maaseya is not the king.

decisions.choice: "Achab fils de Qolaya", "Sédécias fils de Maaséya"
decisions.reason: These two prophets bear the same names as the king of Israel and the king of Judah, so French uses the same forms, "Achab" and "Sédécias", as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "A-háp con trai Cô-la-gia"; "Sê-đê-kia con trai Ma-a-sê-gia"
decisions.reason: "A-háp", "Sê-đê-kia" and "Ma-a-sê-gia" are published forms; "Cô-la-gia" is new. This Zedekiah is a prophet, not the king, which the father's name shows.

decisions.choice: "골라야의 아들 아합"; "마아세야의 아들 시드기야"; "느부갓레살"
decisions.reason: The usual Korean forms of these names; this verse's Hebrew spells the king Nebuchadrezzar (meaning decision m2), so the form changes from verse 3, as the terms note says.

decisions.choice: Acabe, filho de Colaías; Zedequias, filho de Maaseias; Nabucodorosor
decisions.reason: The two prophets take the Portuguese forms of their names, "Acabe" as the king of 1 Kings, and "Colaías"; this Zedequias is not the king (m1). The king of Babylon is "Nabucodorosor" here, as the Hebrew and the English spell him with an r (m2).

decisions.choice: "የቆላያ ልጅ አክዓብ", "የማዕሴያ ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ"
decisions.reason: Ahab and Zedekiah keep the forms of the kings of the same names ("አክዓብ", "ሴዴቅያስ").

decisions.choice: अहाब; कोलायाह; सिदकिय्याह; मासेयाह; नबूकदरेस्सर
decisions.reason: The two false prophets' names keep the forms of the history books (अहाब as the king of 1 Kings, कोलायाह as Nehemiah 11:7, मासेयाह as 1 Chronicles 15:18; this Zedekiah has the king's spelling, as in the Hebrew). The king's name has the r form here, as the Hebrew does (m2).

decisions.choice: Ахав, сын Колаии; Седекия, сын Маасеи; Навуходорносор
decisions.reason: The two prophets take the forms of Nehemiah 11:7 (Колаия) and Chronicles (Маасея); they are not King Ahab or King Zedekiah, but the Hebrew gives the same names. The king's name has the r spelling here, as in 25:1.

decisions.choice: Ahab son of Kolaiah "コラヤの子アハブ", Zedekiah son of Maaseiah "マアセヤの子ツィドキヤ" (the same Japanese as the king's name, as the Hebrew has the same name); Nebuchadrezzar "ネブカドネツァル" (one form for both spellings, JER-1, m2).
decisions.reason: Names: アハブ as 1KI; マアセヤ as JER-3.

source.text: וְלֻקַּ֤ח מֵהֶם֙ קְלָלָ֔ה לְכֹל֙ גָּל֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבָבֶ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר יְשִֽׂמְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ כְּצִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ וּכְאֶחָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־קָלָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be taken from them a curse by all [the] exile of Judah who [are] in Babylon, saying: May make you Yahweh like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom roasted them [the] king of Babylon in the fire,

en.L: And from them a curse will be taken up by all the exiles of Judah who [are] in Babylon, saying, 'May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,'
en.B: Their fate will become a curse that all the exiles of Judah in Babylon will use: 'May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, the men the king of Babylon roasted alive in the fire,'
en.R: All the captives from Judah who are in Babylon will use their names when they curse someone. They will say, 'May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make you end up like Zedekiah and Ahab, who were burned to death by the king of Babylon!'

es.L: Y de ellos se tomará una maldición entre todos los desterrados de Judá que [están] en Babilonia, diciendo: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te haga como a Sedequías y como a Acab, a quienes el rey de Babilonia asó en el fuego”,
es.B: Su destino se convertirá en una maldición que usarán todos los desterrados de Judá que están en Babilonia: “Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te haga como a Sedequías y a Acab, los hombres que el rey de Babilonia asó vivos en el fuego”,
es.R: Todos los prisioneros de Judá que están en Babilonia usarán sus nombres cuando maldigan a alguien. Dirán: “¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te haga terminar como Sedequías y Acab, a quienes el rey de Babilonia quemó vivos!”.

fr.L: Et d’eux on tirera une malédiction parmi tous les exilés de Juda qui [sont] à Babylone, en disant : “Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te traite comme Sédécias et comme Achab, que le roi de Babylone a grillés au feu”,
fr.B: Leur sort deviendra une formule de malédiction pour tous les exilés de Juda qui sont à Babylone : “Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te traite comme Sédécias et Achab, que le roi de Babylone a fait rôtir vifs dans le feu”,
fr.R: Tous les prisonniers de Juda qui sont à Babylone se serviront de leurs noms quand ils voudront maudire quelqu’un. Ils diront : “Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te fasse finir comme Sédécias et Achab, que le roi de Babylone a fait brûler vifs !”

sw.L: Na kwao laana itachukuliwa na mateka wote wa Yuda walioko Babeli, wakisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akufanye kama Sedekia na kama Ahabu, ambao mfalme wa Babeli aliwaoka motoni,'
sw.B: Mwisho wao utakuwa laana ambayo mateka wote wa Yuda walioko Babeli wataitumia: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akufanye kama Sedekia na Ahabu, watu ambao mfalme wa Babeli aliwachoma motoni wakiwa hai,'
sw.R: Mateka wote kutoka Yuda walioko Babeli watalitumia jina lao wanapomlaani mtu. Watasema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akufanye uishie kama Sedekia na Ahabu, waliochomwa moto mpaka kufa na mfalme wa Babeli!'

vi.L: Người ta sẽ lấy chúng làm lời rủa sả giữa mọi người Giu-đa lưu đày ở Ba-by-lôn mà nói: 'Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho ngươi giống như Sê-đê-kia và A-háp, là những kẻ vua Ba-by-lôn đã nướng trong lửa,'
vi.B: Số phận của chúng sẽ thành lời rủa sả mà mọi người Giu-đa lưu đày ở Ba-by-lôn đều dùng: 'Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho ngươi giống như Sê-đê-kia và A-háp, là những kẻ bị vua Ba-by-lôn thiêu sống trong lửa,'
vi.R: Mọi người Giu-đa bị bắt làm tù binh ở Ba-by-lôn sẽ dùng tên chúng mỗi khi nguyền rủa ai. Họ sẽ nói: 'Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho ngươi bị như Sê-đê-kia và A-háp, là những kẻ bị vua Ba-by-lôn thiêu chết!'

ko.L: 그리고 바빌론에 있는 유다의 모든 포로가 그들을 [본보기로] 저주의 말을 삼아 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 바빌론 왕이 불에 구워 죽인 시드기야와 아합처럼 만드시기를 바란다.' 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 바빌론에 있는 유다의 모든 포로가 그들의 운명을 저주의 말로 삼을 것이다. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 바빌론 왕이 산 채로 불에 태워 죽인 시드기야와 아합처럼 만드시기를 바란다.' 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.R: 바빌론에 있는 유다의 모든 포로가 누구를 저주할 때에 그들의 이름을 쓸 것이다. 그들은 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 바빌론 왕에게 불태워 죽임을 당한 시드기야와 아합처럼 되게 하시기를!' 하고 말할 것이다.

pt.L: E deles será tomada uma maldição por todos os exilados de Judá que [estão] na Babilônia, dizendo: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} faça de você como Zedequias e como Acabe, que o rei da Babilônia assou no fogo',
pt.B: A sorte deles se tornará uma maldição que todos os exilados de Judá na Babilônia vão usar: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} faça de você o que fez com Zedequias e Acabe, os homens que o rei da Babilônia assou vivos no fogo',
pt.R: Todos os prisioneiros de Judá que estão na Babilônia vão usar o nome deles quando amaldiçoarem alguém. Eles vão dizer: 'Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faça você acabar como Zedequias e Acabe, que foram queimados vivos pelo rei da Babilônia!'

am.L: በባቢሎን ያሉ የይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ከእነርሱ እርግማን ይወስዳሉ፤ እንዲህም ይላሉ፦ “የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በእሳት እንደ ጠበሳቸው እንደ ሴዴቅያስና እንደ አክዓብ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያድርግህ”፤
am.B: ዕጣ ፈንታቸውም በባቢሎን ያሉ የይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ የሚራገሙበት ይሆናል፦ “የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በሕይወታቸው ሳሉ በእሳት እንደ ጠበሳቸው እንደ ሴዴቅያስና እንደ አክዓብ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያድርግህ”፤
am.R: በባቢሎን ያሉ የይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ሰውን ሲራገሙ ስማቸውን ይጠራሉ። እንዲህም ይላሉ፦ “የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በእሳት አቃጥሎ እንደ ገደላቸው እንደ ሴዴቅያስና እንደ አክዓብ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያድርግህ!”

hi.L: और उनसे यहूदा के सब बंधुए जो बाबुल में [हैं] यह शाप लेंगे, कि, '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हें सिदकिय्याह और अहाब के समान करें, जिन्हें बाबुल के राजा ने आग में भून डाला,'
hi.B: उनका अंत एक शाप बन जाएगा जिसे बाबुल में रहनेवाले यहूदा के सब बंधुए काम में लाएँगे: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हें सिदकिय्याह और अहाब जैसा करें, जिन्हें बाबुल के राजा ने आग में जीवित भून डाला,'
hi.R: बाबुल में रहनेवाले यहूदा के सब बंदी किसी को शाप देते समय उनका नाम लेंगे। वे कहेंगे, '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा भी वही हाल करें जो सिदकिय्याह और अहाब का हुआ, जिन्हें बाबुल के राजा ने जलाकर मार डाला!'

ru.L: И от них возьмут проклятие все изгнанники Иуды, которые в Вавилоне, говоря: “Пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделает тебя, как Седекию и как Ахава, которых царь Вавилона изжарил в огне”,
ru.B: Их участь станет проклятием, которое будут произносить все изгнанники Иуды в Вавилоне: “Пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделает с тобой то же, что с Седекией и Ахавом, которых царь Вавилона заживо сжёг в огне”,
ru.R: Все пленники из Иуды, которые живут в Вавилоне, будут произносить их имена, когда проклинают кого-то. Они будут говорить: “Пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделает с тобой то же, что с Седекией и Ахавом, которых царь Вавилона сжёг заживо!”

ja.L: そして、彼らのことから、バビロンにいるユダのすべての捕囚の民の間で、呪いの言葉が取り上げられる。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたを、バビロンの王が火で焼いたツィドキヤやアハブのようにされるように』と。
ja.B: 彼らの運命は、バビロンにいるユダの捕囚の民がみな使う呪いの言葉となる。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたを、バビロンの王が生きたまま火で焼いたツィドキヤとアハブのようにされるように』と。
ja.R: バビロンにいるユダの捕虜の人々はみな、だれかをのろうときに、この二人の名を使うようになる。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたを、バビロンの王に焼き殺されたツィドキヤとアハブのようにされるように！』と言うのだ。

uk.L: І від них візьмуть прокляття всі вигнанці Юдеї, що [є] у Вавилоні, кажучи: “Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробить тебе, як Седекію і як Ахава, яких цар Вавилону спік у вогні”,
uk.B: Їхня доля стане прокляттям, яке вживатимуть усі вигнанці Юдеї у Вавилоні: “Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробить з тобою те, що з Седекією та Ахавом, яких цар Вавилону живцем спік у вогні”,
uk.R: Усі полонені з Юдеї, що є у Вавилоні, проклинаючи когось, згадуватимуть їхні імена. Вони казатимуть: “Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробить з тобою те, що з Седекією та Ахавом, яких вавилонський цар спалив живцем!”

decisions.choice: a curse ... roasted: a play on words
decisions.reason: The word for "curse" (qelalah) sounds like the verb "roasted" (qalah), and both echo the name of Ahab's father, Kolaiah. The men's very fate becomes the curse people speak.

decisions.choice: roasted in the fire: burned to death, a Babylonian punishment
decisions.reason: Babylonian law named burning as the penalty for some crimes, and Daniel 3 tells of a furnace used to put men to death (Daniel 3:6, 19-23). The two prophets were burned alive.

decisions.choice: a curse will be taken from them: their fate will be used as a curse
decisions.reason: People will take the two men as the pattern for a curse: "may you end up like them". It is what 24:9 and verse 18 mean by a people becoming "a curse" (compare Isaiah 65:15).

decisions.choice: single quotation marks; the sentence runs on into verse 23
decisions.reason: The curse is quoted inside the letter, so it takes single marks. Literal and Balanced end with a comma, since verse 23 gives the reason; Readable ends the sentence here.

decisions.choice: roasted alive (Balanced); burned to death (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "alive" and Readable says plainly what "roasted in the fire" meant (m2); both leave out the second "like", which English does not need.

decisions.choice: "lời rủa sả ... nướng / thiêu"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on "curse" and "roast", which Vietnamese cannot copy; the play is left to meaning decision m1, and Literal keeps the verb "nướng" (roast) as the English does.

decisions.choice: Verse 22 closed as a sentence
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs on into verse 23 with "because"; Korean closes the curse here and verse 23 gives the reason in a sentence of its own. Korean cannot echo the Hebrew play between "curse" and "roasted" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: शाप ... भून डाला
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on the sound of "curse" (qelalah) and "roasted" (qalam) (m1); Hindi cannot copy the play, so each level keeps the plain sense: शाप and आग में भून डालना, Readable "burned to death".

decisions.choice: qelalah ... qalam ba'esh "呪いの言葉" / "火で焼いた" (L), "生きたまま火で焼いた" (B), "焼き殺された" (R): the Hebrew sound play (qelalah, qalah) is not imitated; the footnoted meaning decision states it (m1, m2).
decisions.reason: The curse formula uses a respect form for God ("されるように") as the people speaking of God; the English R's "!" kept at R.

decisions.choice: The English runs on into verse 23 ("because..."); Japanese ends verse 22 with the quoted curse and gives the reason as its own sentence in verse 23.
decisions.reason: Each verse's content stays after its own marker.

source.text: יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשׂ֨וּ נְבָלָ֜ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיְנַֽאֲפוּ֙ אֶת־נְשֵׁ֣י רֵֽעֵיהֶ֔ם וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ דָבָ֤ר בִּשְׁמִי֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר ל֣וֹא צִוִּיתִ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֛י הַיּוֹדֵ֥עַוָעֵ֖ד נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: because that they did folly in Israel, and they committed adultery with [the] wives of their neighbors, and they spoke a word in my name [of] falsehood, which not I commanded them; and I [am] the [one] knowing and witness, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: because they have done an outrage in Israel, and they have committed adultery with their neighbors' wives, and they have spoken in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name a lying word, which I did not command them; and I [am] the one who knows, and [I am] witness, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: because they have done a disgraceful thing in Israel. They have committed adultery with their neighbors' wives and have spoken lies in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, words I did not command them to speak. I am the one who knows it, and I am witness to it, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: This will happen because they have done shameful things in Israel. They have slept with other men's wives. And they have told lies and said that the messages came from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, when I never told them to say anything. I know all about it, and I am a witness to it, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: porque cometieron una infamia en Israel, y cometieron adulterio con las mujeres de sus prójimos, y hablaron en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre palabra mentirosa, que no les mandé; y yo [soy] el que sabe, y [soy] testigo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: porque hicieron algo vergonzoso en Israel. Cometieron adulterio con las mujeres de sus vecinos y dijeron mentiras en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, palabras que yo no les mandé decir. Yo soy el que lo sabe, y soy testigo de ello, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Esto pasará porque han hecho cosas vergonzosas en Israel. Se han acostado con las esposas de otros hombres. Y han dicho mentiras, afirmando que los mensajes venían de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, cuando yo nunca les mandé decir nada. Yo lo sé todo, y soy testigo de ello, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: parce qu’ils ont commis une infamie en Israël, qu’ils ont commis l’adultère avec les femmes de leurs prochains, et qu’ils ont dit en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom une parole de mensonge, ce que je ne leur avais pas ordonné ; et c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui sais, et [je suis] témoin, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: parce qu’ils ont commis une infamie en Israël. Ils ont commis l’adultère avec les femmes de leurs prochains et ont dit des mensonges en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, des paroles que je ne leur avais pas ordonné de dire. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui le sais, et j’en suis témoin, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Cela arrivera parce qu’ils ont fait des choses honteuses en Israël. Ils ont couché avec les femmes d’autres hommes. Ils ont dit des mensonges en prétendant que ces messages venaient de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, alors que je ne leur avais jamais rien dit de dire. Je sais tout cela, et j’en suis témoin, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: kwa sababu wamefanya upumbavu katika Israeli, nao wamezini na wake za jirani zao, nao wamenena kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} neno la uongo, nisilowaamuru; nami [ndimi] ninayejua, nami [ni] shahidi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: kwa sababu wametenda jambo la aibu katika Israeli. Wamezini na wake za jirani zao na kusema uongo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, maneno ambayo sikuwaamuru kusema. Mimi ndiye ninayejua, nami ni shahidi wa jambo hilo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Hilo litatokea kwa sababu wametenda mambo ya aibu katika Israeli. Wamelala na wake za watu wengine. Tena wamesema uongo na kudai kwamba ujumbe wao ulitoka {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, wakati sikuwaambia waseme lolote. Ninajua yote kuhusu jambo hilo, nami ni shahidi wake, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: vì chúng đã làm điều ô nhục trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã phạm tội ngoại tình với vợ người lân cận, và đã nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói lời giả dối mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không truyền cho chúng; chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] Đấng biết, và [Ta là] nhân chứng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.B: vì chúng đã làm điều ô nhục trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Chúng đã ngoại tình với vợ người lân cận và nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói những lời dối trá mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không hề truyền cho chúng. Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết điều ấy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là nhân chứng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.R: Việc ấy sẽ xảy ra vì chúng đã làm những điều đáng xấu hổ trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Chúng đã ngủ với vợ của người khác. Chúng đã nói dối và bảo rằng sứ điệp ấy đến từ Ta, trong khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chẳng hề bảo chúng nói gì cả. Ta biết hết mọi điều ấy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là nhân chứng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán."

ko.L: 그것은 그들이 이스라엘에서 망령된 일을 행하고, 그들의 이웃의 아내들과 간음하고, 내가 그들에게 명령하지 않은 거짓말을 내 이름으로 말했기 때문이다. 나는 아는 자이며 증인이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다."
ko.B: 그것은 그들이 이스라엘에서 수치스러운 일을 저질렀기 때문이다. 그들은 이웃의 아내들과 간음하고, 내가 그들에게 명령하지도 않은 거짓말을 내 이름으로 했다. 나는 그 일을 알고 있고, 그 일의 증인이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."
ko.R: 이런 일이 일어나는 것은 그들이 이스라엘에서 부끄러운 짓을 했기 때문이다. 그들은 다른 남자들의 아내들과 잠자리를 같이했다. 그리고 거짓말을 하면서 그것이 내가 준 말이라고 했다. 나는 그들에게 아무것도 말하라고 한 적이 없다. 나는 그 일을 다 알고 있고, 그 일의 증인이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."

pt.L: porque cometeram uma infâmia em Israel, e cometeram adultério com as mulheres dos seus próximos, e falaram em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome uma palavra mentirosa, que eu não lhes ordenei; e eu [sou] aquele que sabe, e [sou] testemunha, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.B: porque cometeram uma infâmia em Israel. Cometeram adultério com as mulheres dos seus vizinhos e falaram mentiras em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, palavras que eu não lhes mandei falar. Eu sou aquele que sabe, e eu sou testemunha disso, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.R: Isso vai acontecer porque eles fizeram coisas vergonhosas em Israel. Dormiram com as mulheres de outros homens. E contaram mentiras, dizendo que as mensagens vinham de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, quando eu nunca lhes mandei dizer nada. Eu sei de tudo, e sou testemunha disso, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."

am.L: በእስራኤል መካከል ነውር አድርገዋልና፤ ከባልንጀሮቻቸውም ሚስቶች ጋር አመንዝረዋል፤ ያላዘዝኋቸውንም የሐሰት ቃል በስሜ ተናግረዋል፤ እኔም የማውቅ ምስክርም ነኝ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።»
am.B: በእስራኤል መካከል አሳፋሪ ነገር አድርገዋልና። ከባልንጀሮቻቸው ሚስቶች ጋር አመንዝረዋል፤ ያላዘዝኋቸውን የሐሰት ቃል በስሜ ተናግረዋል። ይህን የማውቅ እኔ ነኝ፤ ምስክሩም እኔ ነኝ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።»
am.R: ይህ የሚሆነው በእስራኤል መካከል አሳፋሪ ነገር ስላደረጉ ነው። ከሌሎች ሰዎች ሚስቶች ጋር አመንዝረዋል። እኔ ፈጽሞ ያላዘዝኋቸውን ሐሰት ተናግረው መልእክቱ ከእኔ ነው አሉ። ሁሉን አውቃለሁ፤ ምስክርም ነኝ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።»

hi.L: क्योंकि उन्होंने इस्राएल में मूर्खता का घृणित काम किया है, और अपने पड़ोसियों की पत्नियों के साथ व्यभिचार किया है, और मेरे नाम से झूठा वचन कहा है, जिसकी आज्ञा मैंने उन्हें नहीं दी; और मैं ही [वह हूँ] जो जानता है, और [मैं] गवाह [हूँ], {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।"
hi.B: क्योंकि उन्होंने इस्राएल में घिनौना काम किया है। उन्होंने अपने पड़ोसियों की पत्नियों के साथ व्यभिचार किया है और मेरे नाम से झूठ बोला है, ऐसे वचन जिन्हें कहने की आज्ञा मैंने उन्हें नहीं दी। मैं ही इसे जानता हूँ, और मैं इसका गवाह हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।"
hi.R: यह इसलिए होगा क्योंकि उन्होंने इस्राएल में शर्मनाक काम किए हैं। उन्होंने दूसरे पुरुषों की पत्नियों के साथ संबंध बनाए हैं। और उन्होंने झूठ बोलकर कहा है कि उनके संदेश मेरी ओर से हैं, जबकि मैंने उन्हें कुछ भी कहने को नहीं कहा। मैं इसके बारे में सब जानता हूँ, और मैं इसका गवाह हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।"

ru.L: за то, что они сделали мерзость в Израиле и прелюбодействовали с жёнами своих ближних, и говорили {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем лживое слово, которого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не повелевал им; а {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — знающий и свидетель, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.»
ru.B: за то, что они совершили в Израиле позорное дело. Они прелюбодействовали с жёнами своих ближних и говорили ложь {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем — слова, которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не повелевал им говорить. Я знаю это и свидетельствую об этом, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»
ru.R: Это случится, потому что они делали в Израиле постыдное. Они спали с чужими жёнами. И они говорили ложь и утверждали, что эти слова от {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, хотя {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} никогда не велел им ничего говорить. Я знаю об этом всё и свидетельствую об этом, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.»

ja.L: 彼らはイスラエルで恥ずべきことを行い、隣人たちの妻と姦淫を犯し、わたしが彼らに命じなかった偽りの言葉を、わたしの名によって語ったからだ。わたしこそ、それを知る者であり、証人である――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。」
ja.B: 彼らがイスラエルで恥ずべきことを行ったからである。彼らは隣人の妻と姦淫を犯し、わたしが命じもしなかった偽りの言葉を、わたしの名によって語った。わたしこそ、それを知っている者であり、その証人である、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。」
ja.R: そうなるのは、彼らがイスラエルで恥ずかしいことをしたからだ。彼らは、ほかの男の妻と寝た。また、わたしが何も語れと命じていないのに、うそを語り、それがわたしからのお告げだと言った。わたしは、そのすべてを知っている。わたしがその証人だ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。」

uk.L: за те, що вони вчинили безчестя в Ізраїлі, і чинили перелюб з жінками своїх ближніх, і говорили {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям слово неправдиве, якого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не наказував їм; а {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} той, хто знає, і [{{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}] свідок, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}».
uk.B: за те, що вони вчинили ганебне в Ізраїлі. Вони чинили перелюб з жінками своїх ближніх і говорили неправду {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} імʼям, слова, яких {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не наказував їм говорити. Я той, хто це знає, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} свідок цього, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}».
uk.R: Це станеться тому, що вони чинили ганебні речі в Ізраїлі. Вони спали з чужими жінками. Вони говорили брехню й казали, що це послання від {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, хоч {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ніколи не наказував їм нічого говорити. Я все про це знаю, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} свідок цього, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}».

decisions.choice: the one who knows: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) can be read "he knows"; the scribes marked "the one who knows" to be read aloud (qere). Both say that God himself knows what they have done.

decisions.choice: an outrage: a shameful act that breaks the bonds of the community
decisions.reason: The word names a deed so gross that it disgraces the whole people, often a sexual crime (Genesis 34:7; Deuteronomy 22:21; Judges 20:6, 10) or a breach of what is holy (Joshua 7:15). "In Israel" means among God's people.

decisions.choice: adultery with their neighbors' wives: a breach of the commandments
decisions.reason: The law forbade adultery and desire for a neighbor's wife (Exodus 20:14, 17). Jeremiah had charged the prophets of Jerusalem with the same sin (23:14).

decisions.choice: I am the one who knows and the witness
decisions.reason: In a court a witness testifies to what he has seen. God himself has seen what these men did, even if it was hidden from others, and he will testify against them (compare Malachi 3:5; Micah 1:2).

decisions.choice: a closing quotation mark
decisions.reason: The letter that began in verse 4 ends here.

decisions.choice: slept with other men's wives; told lies and said that the messages came from me
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what adultery is and what speaking lies in God's name means. "I never told them to say anything" gives "which I did not command them".

decisions.choice: nevalah "恥ずべきこと" (L, B), "恥ずかしいこと" (R) (m2); na'af "姦淫を犯す" (L, B), R "ほかの男の妻と寝た" as the English R (m3); hayyodea' va'ed "知る者であり、証人である" (m4); the letter's 「 closes here as the English closes its quotation.
decisions.reason: JER-1 na'af (L, B); R follows the English R's plain wording.

decisions.choice: and to Shemaiah you shall say: God now speaks to Jeremiah
decisions.reason: A new section starts without an introduction. The "you" is singular: God tells Jeremiah what to say to Shemaiah, a prophet among the exiles who had written to Jerusalem in reply to Jeremiah's letter. The speech is broken off at verse 28 and finished in verses 31-32.

decisions.choice: the Nehelamite: of an unknown place or family
decisions.reason: The word names where Shemaiah or his family came from, but no place called Nehelam is known. It sounds like the word for "dream", and some think it may be a nickname for a man who trusted dreams (verse 8), but this cannot be shown.

decisions.choice: an opening quotation mark
decisions.reason: God's words to Jeremiah are quoted from here to verse 28. The message to Shemaiah inside them takes single marks, his letter double marks again, and the words he quotes from Jeremiah single marks.

decisions.choice: Give this message to
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "you shall say, saying" means.

decisions.choice: Semaías el nehelamita
decisions.reason: The name and its unknown place-name keep the forms the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: « » for God's words to Jeremiah (verses 24-28 and 30-32), “ ” for the message to Shemaiah and to the exiles, ‘ ’ for Shemaiah's letter, « » again for Jeremiah's words quoted in it at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: French uses its usual order of marks, as in 27:4; a fourth level returns to « », and Readable reports Jeremiah's words without marks, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Sê-ma-gia người Nê-hê-lam"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for Shemaiah the Nehelamite; "Nê-hê-lam" is new and stands for an unknown place or family, as meaning decision m2 says.

decisions.choice: "느헬람 사람 스마야"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form.

decisions.choice: Semaías, o neelamita; tu (God to Jeremiah, and to Shemaiah, verses 25 and 31-32); você (Shemaiah to Zephaniah, verses 26-27)
decisions.reason: The name takes its usual Brazilian form, as the shared rules for Jeremiah have it, and "neelamita" is written as Portuguese writes the sounds of the unknown place (m2). God speaks to Jeremiah and in his message to Shemaiah with "tu", as to one person; Shemaiah's own letter speaks to the priest Zephaniah with "você", as people speak to each other.

decisions.choice: "ኔሔላማዊው ሸማያ" (Shemaiah the Nehelamite); "ሶፎንያስ" (Zephaniah, v. 25); "ዮዳሄ" (Jehoiada, v. 26)
decisions.reason: Shemaiah, Zephaniah and Jehoiada keep the forms on main; Nehelamite is written from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: नेहेलामी शमायाह
decisions.reason: The Nehelamite names an unknown place or family (m2), so Hindi keeps the Hebrew's gentilic form (नेहेलामी) at every level, as the English does; Shemaiah as 26:20.

decisions.choice: Шемаия нехеламитянин
decisions.reason: Shemaiah keeps the form of Kings and Chronicles, as in 26:20; "Nehelamite" names his family or home, written as a lowercase word like other such names (морешетянин).
