records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel, saying: Because that you sent in your name letters to all the people who [are] in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying:

en.L: 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel, saying: Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who [are] in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
en.B: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: You sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest and to all the priests. You wrote:
en.R: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: You sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem. You sent them to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest and to all the other priests. You wrote:

es.L: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, diciendo: Por cuanto tú enviaste cartas en tu propio nombre a todo el pueblo que [está] en Jerusalén, y a Sofonías hijo de Maasías, el sacerdote, y a todos los sacerdotes, diciendo:
es.B: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: Tú enviaste cartas en tu propio nombre a todo el pueblo que está en Jerusalén, al sacerdote Sofonías hijo de Maasías y a todos los sacerdotes. Escribiste:
es.R: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Tú enviaste cartas en tu propio nombre a todo el pueblo de Jerusalén. Se las enviaste al sacerdote Sofonías hijo de Maasías y a todos los demás sacerdotes. Escribiste:

fr.L: “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, disant : Parce que tu as envoyé en ton propre nom des lettres à tout le peuple qui [est] à Jérusalem, et à Sophonie fils de Maaséya, le prêtre, et à tous les prêtres, pour dire :
fr.B: “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Tu as envoyé en ton propre nom des lettres à tout le peuple de Jérusalem, au prêtre Sophonie fils de Maaséya et à tous les prêtres. Tu as écrit :
fr.R: “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Tu as envoyé en ton propre nom des lettres à tout le peuple de Jérusalem. Tu les as envoyées au prêtre Sophonie, fils de Maaséya, et à tous les autres prêtres. Tu as écrit :

sw.L: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi, kusema: Kwa sababu umetuma barua kwa jina lako mwenyewe kwa watu wote walioko Yerusalemu, na kwa Sefania mwana wa Maaseya kuhani, na kwa makuhani wote, ukisema,
sw.B: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Ulituma barua kwa jina lako mwenyewe kwa watu wote walioko Yerusalemu, kwa Sefania mwana wa Maaseya kuhani na kwa makuhani wote. Uliandika:
sw.R: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Ulituma barua kwa jina lako mwenyewe kwa watu wote walioko Yerusalemu. Ulizituma kwa Sefania mwana wa Maaseya kuhani na kwa makuhani wengine wote. Uliandika:

vi.L: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này rằng: Vì ngươi đã nhân danh mình gửi thư cho toàn dân ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, cho thầy tế lễ Sô-phô-ni con trai Ma-a-sê-gia, và cho tất cả các thầy tế lễ rằng:
vi.B: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Ngươi đã nhân danh mình gửi thư cho toàn dân ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, cho thầy tế lễ Sô-phô-ni con trai Ma-a-sê-gia và cho tất cả các thầy tế lễ. Ngươi viết:
vi.R: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Ngươi đã nhân danh mình gửi thư cho toàn dân ở Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ngươi gửi thư cho thầy tế lễ Sô-phô-ni con trai Ma-a-sê-gia và cho mọi thầy tế lễ khác. Ngươi viết:

ko.L: '이스라엘의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 네가 네 이름으로 예루살렘에 있는 모든 백성과 마아세야의 아들 제사장 스바냐와 모든 제사장에게 편지를 보내어 말하기를,
ko.B: '이스라엘의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너는 네 이름으로 예루살렘에 있는 모든 백성과 마아세야의 아들 제사장 스바냐와 모든 제사장에게 편지를 보냈다. 너는 이렇게 썼다.
ko.R: '이스라엘의 하나님, 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너는 네 이름으로 예루살렘에 있는 모든 백성에게 편지를 보냈다. 마아세야의 아들 제사장 스바냐와 다른 모든 제사장에게도 보냈다. 너는 이렇게 썼다.

pt.L: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, dizendo: Porque tu enviaste cartas em teu [próprio] nome a todo o povo que [está] em Jerusalém, e a Sofonias, filho de Maaseias, o sacerdote, e a todos os sacerdotes, dizendo:
pt.B: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Tu enviaste cartas em teu próprio nome a todo o povo de Jerusalém, ao sacerdote Sofonias, filho de Maaseias, e a todos os sacerdotes. Tu escreveste:
pt.R: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, diz: Tu enviaste cartas em teu próprio nome a todo o povo de Jerusalém. Tu as enviaste ao sacerdote Sofonias, filho de Maaseias, e a todos os outros sacerdotes. Tu escreveste:

am.L: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ እንዲህ ይላል፦ በኢየሩሳሌም ወዳሉት ሕዝብ ሁሉ፣ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ ማዕሴያ ልጅ ወደ ሶፎንያስ፣ ወደ ካህናቱም ሁሉ በገዛ ስምህ ደብዳቤዎችን ስለ ላክህ፣ እንዲህ ስትል፦
am.B: “የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ እንዲህ ይላል፦ በኢየሩሳሌም ላሉት ሕዝብ ሁሉ፣ ለካህኑ ለማዕሴያ ልጅ ለሶፎንያስና ለካህናቱ ሁሉ በገዛ ስምህ ደብዳቤዎችን ላክህ። እንዲህም ብለህ ጻፍህ፦
am.R: “የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ እንዲህ ይላል፦ በኢየሩሳሌም ላሉት ሕዝብ ሁሉ በገዛ ስምህ ደብዳቤዎችን ላክህ። ለካህኑ ለማዕሴያ ልጅ ለሶፎንያስና ለሌሎቹ ካህናት ሁሉ ላክሃቸው። እንዲህም ብለህ ጻፍህ፦

hi.L: 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यों कहते हैं: इसलिए कि तुमने अपने ही नाम से यरूशलेम के सब लोगों को, और मासेयाह के पुत्र सपन्याह याजक को, और सब याजकों को पत्र भेजे, कि,
hi.B: 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यह कहते हैं: तुमने अपने ही नाम से यरूशलेम के सब लोगों को, मासेयाह के पुत्र सपन्याह याजक को और सब याजकों को पत्र भेजे। तुमने लिखा:
hi.R: 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यह कहते हैं: तुमने अपने ही नाम से यरूशलेम के सब लोगों को पत्र भेजे। तुमने उन्हें मासेयाह के बेटे सपन्याह याजक को और बाक़ी सब याजकों को भेजा। तुमने लिखा:

ru.L: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля, говоря: За то, что ты послал от своего имени письма всему народу, который в Иерусалиме, и Софонии, сыну Маасеи, священнику, и всем священникам, говоря:
ru.B: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Ты послал от своего имени письма всему народу в Иерусалиме, священнику Софонии, сыну Маасеи, и всем священникам. Ты написал:
ru.R: “Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, Бог Израиля: Ты послал от своего имени письма всему народу в Иерусалиме. Ты послал их священнику Софонии, сыну Маасеи, и всем остальным священникам. Ты написал:

ja.L: 『万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。あなたは、自分の名で、エルサレムにいるすべての民と、マアセヤの子である祭司ゼファニヤと、すべての祭司たちに手紙を送って、こう言ったので、
ja.B: 『万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。あなたは、自分の名で、エルサレムにいるすべての民と、マアセヤの子で祭司のゼファニヤと、すべての祭司たちに手紙を送った。あなたはこう書いた。
ja.R: 『天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。あなたは、自分の名で、エルサレムにいるすべての人々に手紙を送った。マアセヤの息子で祭司のゼファニヤにも、ほかのすべての祭司たちにも送った。あなたはこう書いた。

uk.L: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, Бог Ізраїлю, кажучи: За те, що ти послав від свого імені листи всьому народові, що [є] в Єрусалимі, і Софонії, синові Маасеї, священникові, і всім священникам, кажучи:
uk.B: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, Бог Ізраїлю: Ти послав від свого імені листи всьому народові в Єрусалимі, Софонії, синові Маасеї, священникові, і всім священникам. Ти писав:
uk.R: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, Бог Ізраїлю: Ти посилав від свого імені листи всім людям в Єрусалимі. Ти посилав їх Софонії, синові Маасеї, священникові, і всім іншим священникам. Ти писав:

decisions.choice: because you sent: a sentence left unfinished
decisions.reason: The sentence begins "because" but never reaches its "therefore". The quotation of Shemaiah's letter runs on to verse 28, and the judgment comes only in verses 31-32, where "because ... therefore" is spoken in full.

decisions.choice: in your own name: on your own authority
decisions.reason: The other prophets spoke falsely "in my name" (verses 9, 21, 23). Shemaiah wrote in his own name, giving orders to the priests in Jerusalem without any word from God.

decisions.choice: Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest: the second-ranking priest in the temple
decisions.reason: Zephaniah was the "second priest", next to the chief priest (52:24), and King Zedekiah twice sent him to ask Jeremiah for a word from the LORD (21:1; 37:3). He was put to death by the Babylonians after Jerusalem fell (52:24-27).

decisions.choice: You sent letters ... You wrote:
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the charge without "because", since the sentence it begins is not finished (m1), and say "You wrote" for "saying". Readable breaks the verse into short sentences.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L); "... 이렇게 말씀하신다" (B); "... 하시는 말씀이다" (R), with the honorific, though the formula stands inside God's words to Jeremiah
alternatives: "주가 이와 같이 말한다" (God naming himself plainly)
decisions.reason: One rule for Isaiah, Jeremiah and Ezra: the messenger formula keeps the honorific even where God dictates the message, as published at 1 Kings 21:19, 2 Samuel 7:5 and 1 Chronicles 17:4; God's own words that follow stay in the plain style, without -시- for himself.

decisions.choice: सपन्याह
decisions.reason: Zephaniah the priest keeps the form of 2 Kings 25:18 in this translation, where the same man is named as the second priest.

decisions.choice: Софония, сын Маасеи
decisions.reason: The priest Zephaniah keeps the form of 2 Kings 25:18.

decisions.choice: ya'an 'asher "……ので、" (L), a sentence left unfinished as the Hebrew (m1); B, R make it a plain statement as the English B, R; bishmekha "自分の名で" (every level, on his own authority, m2); Zephaniah son of Maaseiah "マアセヤの子……ゼファニヤ" as JER 21:1.
decisions.reason: JER-3 names.

source.text: יְהוָ֞ה נְתָנְךָ֣ כֹהֵ֗ן תַּ֚חַת יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לִֽהְי֤וֹת פְּקִדִים֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְכָל־אִ֥ישׁ מְשֻׁגָּ֖ע וּמִתְנַבֵּ֑א וְנָתַתָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ אֶל־הַמַּהְפֶּ֖כֶת וְאֶל־הַצִּינֹֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh has made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, to be overseers [in the] house of Yahweh for every man [who is] mad and acting the prophet, and you will put him into the stocks and into the collar.

en.L: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made you priest in place of Jehoiada the priest, to be overseers in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} over every man who is mad and acts the prophet, and you are to put him in the stocks and in the collar.
en.B: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made you priest in place of Jehoiada the priest, so that there would be officers in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to deal with any madman who sets himself up as a prophet. You should put such a man in the stocks and the neck irons.
en.R: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made you priest in place of Jehoiada the priest. You are in charge in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. You are supposed to watch for any crazy person who acts like a prophet. You should lock him in the stocks with an iron collar around his neck.

es.L: ‘{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha puesto por sacerdote en lugar del sacerdote Joiada, para que haya inspectores en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sobre todo hombre loco que se hace profeta, y lo pongas en el cepo y en la argolla.
es.B: ‘{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha puesto como sacerdote en lugar del sacerdote Joiada, para que haya oficiales en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que se encarguen de cualquier loco que se haga pasar por profeta. A un hombre así debes ponerlo en el cepo y en la argolla.
es.R: ‘{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te hizo sacerdote en lugar del sacerdote Joiada. Tú estás a cargo en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Tu deber es vigilar a cualquier loco que actúe como profeta. Debes encerrarlo en el cepo con una argolla de hierro en el cuello.

fr.L: ‘{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a établi prêtre à la place de Yehoyada le prêtre, pour qu’il y ait des surveillants dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour tout homme qui délire et qui fait le prophète, et tu dois le mettre aux ceps et au carcan.
fr.B: ‘{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a établi prêtre à la place du prêtre Yehoyada, pour qu’il y ait dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des responsables chargés de s’occuper de tout fou qui se pose en prophète. Tu dois mettre un tel homme aux ceps et au carcan.
fr.R: ‘{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a fait prêtre à la place du prêtre Yehoyada. C’est toi le responsable dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Tu dois surveiller tous les fous qui se prennent pour des prophètes. Tu dois les attacher dans les ceps, avec un collier de fer autour du cou.

sw.L: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekufanya kuhani mahali pa Yehoyada kuhani, ili kuwe na wasimamizi katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} juu ya kila mtu mwenye wazimu ajifanyaye nabii, nawe umtie katika mkatale na katika kongwa.
sw.B: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekufanya kuhani mahali pa Yehoyada kuhani, ili kuwe na wasimamizi katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa kumshughulikia kila mwenye wazimu anayejifanya nabii. Mtu kama huyo unapaswa kumtia katika mkatale na pingu za shingo.
sw.R: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikufanya kuhani mahali pa Yehoyada kuhani. Wewe ndiye msimamizi katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Unapaswa kumwangalia kila mtu mwenye wazimu anayejifanya nabii. Unapaswa kumfunga katika mkatale na kumvalisha kongwa la chuma shingoni.

vi.L: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập ông làm thầy tế lễ thay cho thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa, để làm những người coi sóc trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cai quản mọi kẻ điên khùng tự xưng là tiên tri, và ông phải cùm kẻ ấy và đeo gông vào cổ nó.
vi.B: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập ông làm thầy tế lễ thay cho thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa, để có những người coi sóc trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trị mọi kẻ điên khùng tự xưng là tiên tri. Ông phải cùm kẻ ấy lại và đeo gông sắt vào cổ nó.
vi.R: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập ông làm thầy tế lễ thay cho thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa. Ông được giao coi sóc đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông có nhiệm vụ canh chừng mọi kẻ điên khùng làm như mình là tiên tri. Ông phải cùm kẻ ấy lại và đeo vòng sắt vào cổ nó.

ko.L: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 제사장 여호야다를 대신하여 제사장님을 제사장으로 세우셔서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 미쳐서 예언자 노릇을 하는 모든 사람을 감독하게 하셨습니다. 그런 자는 차꼬와 칼을 채워야 합니다.
ko.B: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 제사장 여호야다 대신 제사장님을 제사장으로 세우셨습니다. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 감독관들을 두어, 미쳐서 예언자 행세를 하는 사람을 다스리게 하시려는 것입니다. 그런 사람은 차꼬를 채우고 목에 쇠칼을 씌워야 합니다.
ko.R: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 제사장 여호야다 대신 제사장님을 제사장으로 세우셨습니다. 제사장님은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 맡고 계십니다. 제사장님은 미친 사람이 예언자인 척하지 못하게 지켜보셔야 합니다. 그런 사람은 차꼬에 채우고 목에 쇠고리를 씌워 가두셔야 합니다.

pt.L: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez de você sacerdote no lugar do sacerdote Joiada, para que haja supervisores na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} sobre todo homem louco que se faz de profeta, e você o porá no tronco e na argola.
pt.B: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez de você sacerdote no lugar do sacerdote Joiada, para que houvesse oficiais na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que cuidassem de todo louco que se faz de profeta. Você deve pôr esse homem no tronco e na argola de ferro.
pt.R: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez de você sacerdote no lugar do sacerdote Joiada. Você é o responsável no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Você deve vigiar todo louco que age como profeta. Deve prendê-lo no tronco, com uma argola de ferro no pescoço.

am.L: ‘{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ፋንታ ካህን አድርጎሃል፤ ይኸውም ያበደውንና ራሱን ነቢይ የሚያደርገውን ሰው ሁሉ እንድትቆጣጠሩ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤት ተቆጣጣሪዎች ትሆኑ ዘንድ ነው፤ እርሱንም በግንድና በአንገት ብረት ታስገባዋለህ።
am.B: ‘{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ፋንታ ካህን አድርጎሃል፤ ይኸውም ያበደውንና ራሱን ነቢይ የሚያደርገውን ሰው ሁሉ የሚቆጣጠሩ ሹሞች {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ እንዲኖሩ ነው። እንዲህ ያለውን ሰው በግንድና በአንገት ብረት ልታስረው ይገባሃል።
am.R: ‘{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ፋንታ ካህን አድርጎሃል። አንተ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ኃላፊ ነህ። ነቢይ መስሎ የሚሠራውን እብድ ሰው ሁሉ መከታተል አለብህ። እንዲህ ያለውን ሰው በግንድ ቆልፈህ በአንገቱ የብረት ቀለበት ልታደርግበት ይገባል።

hi.L: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यहोयादा याजक के स्थान पर तुम्हें याजक ठहराया है, कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में हर उस मनुष्य पर अधिकारी हों जो पागल है और भविष्यद्वक्ता बनता है, और तुम उसे काठ में और गले की बेड़ी में डालो।
hi.B: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यहोयादा याजक के स्थान पर तुम्हें याजक बनाया है, कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में ऐसे अधिकारी हों जो हर उस पागल से निपटें जो भविष्यद्वक्ता बन बैठता है। तुम्हें ऐसे मनुष्य को काठ में और गले की लोहे की बेड़ी में डालना चाहिए।
hi.R: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यहोयादा याजक के स्थान पर तुम्हें याजक बनाया है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मंदिर की ज़िम्मेदारी तुम पर है। तुम्हें हर उस सनकी आदमी पर नज़र रखनी है जो नबी होने का दिखावा करता है। तुम्हें उसे काठ में जकड़कर उसके गले में लोहे का पट्टा डाल देना चाहिए।

ru.L: ‘{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поставил тебя священником вместо Иодая-священника, чтобы были надзиратели в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} над всяким человеком, безумствующим и пророчествующим, и ты должен сажать его в колоду и в ошейник.
ru.B: ‘{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поставил тебя священником вместо священника Иодая, чтобы в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} были надзиратели за каждым безумцем, который выдаёт себя за пророка. Такого человека ты должен сажать в колодки и в железный ошейник.
ru.R: ‘{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал тебя священником вместо священника Иодая. Ты отвечаешь за порядок в храме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Ты должен следить за каждым сумасшедшим, который ведёт себя как пророк. Такого человека ты должен заковывать в колодки и надевать ему на шею железный ошейник.

ja.L: 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、祭司ヨヤダに代わって、あなたを祭司とされた。それは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家に監督たちを置き、狂って預言者のように振る舞うすべての者に[当たらせる]ためである。あなたは、その者を足かせと首かせにつながなければならない。
ja.B: 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、祭司ヨヤダに代わって、あなたを祭司に任じられた。それは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家に監督の役人たちを置き、預言者を気取る狂った者たちを取り締まらせるためである。あなたは、そのような者を足かせと首かせにつなぐべきだ。
ja.R: 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、祭司ヨヤダの代わりに、あなたを祭司にされた。あなたは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の責任者だ。あなたは、預言者のように振る舞うおかしな者がいないか、見張っていなければならない。そういう者は、足かせにつなぎ、首に鉄の輪をはめておくべきだ。

uk.L: ‘{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} поставив тебе священником замість священника Єгояди, щоб були наглядачі в домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} над кожним чоловіком, що божеволіє і пророкує, і щоб ти садив його в колоду і в нашийник.
uk.B: ‘{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} поставив тебе священником замість священника Єгояди, щоб у домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} були наглядачі за кожним безумцем, який видає себе за пророка. Таку людину ти повинен забивати в колоду й у залізний нашийник.
uk.R: ‘{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробив тебе священником замість священника Єгояди. Ти наглядаєш за порядком у храмі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Ти повинен пильнувати, щоб жоден божевільний не вдавав із себе пророка. Такого треба замикати в колоду й надівати йому на шию залізний нашийник.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada the priest: probably the priest who guarded the temple for young King Joash
decisions.reason: Jehoiada led the overthrow of Queen Athaliah and set guards over the house of the LORD (2 Kings 11:4-18). Shemaiah may name him as the model of a priest who kept order in the temple, or he may mean a later priest of that name, perhaps Zephaniah's predecessor, of whom nothing else is known.

decisions.choice: to be overseers: the priest and the officers under him
decisions.reason: The noun is plural. Zephaniah and the priests with him are to be the temple's officers. Pashhur had held this office of overseer when he put Jeremiah in the stocks (20:1-2).

decisions.choice: mad and acting the prophet: a sneer at prophets
decisions.reason: The first word means insane, raving. It was used in scorn of prophets (2 Kings 9:11; Hosea 9:7). The verb form for "prophesy" can describe raving behavior (1 Samuel 18:10). Shemaiah means any wild man who claims to speak for God.

decisions.choice: the stocks and the collar: devices for holding a prisoner
decisions.reason: The stocks are the device in which Pashhur held Jeremiah (20:2). The second word is found only here. It may name a collar or iron band for the neck; some take it as a narrow cell.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks for Shemaiah's letter
decisions.reason: Shemaiah's letter is quoted inside the LORD's message to him, which is quoted inside the LORD's words to Jeremiah, so it takes double marks again.

decisions.choice: sets himself up as a prophet, neck irons (Balanced); acts like a prophet, iron collar (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the scorn in the verb (m3) and say what the collar was. Readable says "crazy person" for the madman and begins new sentences.

decisions.choice: ‘ ’ for Shemaiah's letter
decisions.reason: Shemaiah's letter is the third level of speech (the LORD to Jeremiah « », the message to Shemaiah “ ”), so it takes ‘ ’; its quotation of Jeremiah in verse 28 is put in “ ” again.

decisions.choice: "aux ceps et au carcan" (L, B); "dans les ceps, avec un collier de fer autour du cou" (R)
decisions.reason: "Ceps" as in 20:2; the second device held the neck, which "carcan" names.

decisions.choice: "cùm" (stocks) and "gông" (collar)
decisions.reason: The stocks are "cùm", as for Jeremiah in 20:2, and the collar for the neck is "gông". Shemaiah writes to the priest with the respectful "ông".

decisions.choice: Shemaiah writes to the priest Zephaniah in 합쇼체, calling him "제사장님"
decisions.reason: A letter to a senior priest is polite; Korean avoids a second-person pronoun and uses his title. The letter takes double quotation marks inside the LORD's message, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "차꼬와 칼" (L); "차꼬 ... 쇠칼" (B)
decisions.reason: "칼" is the Korean name for a wooden or iron collar locked on a prisoner's neck (meaning decision m4); Balanced adds "쇠" to make it plain.

decisions.choice: Shemaiah's letter is a third-level quotation (‘ ’); Jeremiah's words quoted inside it in verse 28 a fourth level, marked “ ” again
decisions.reason: Verses 24-28 nest four speeches (the LORD to Jeremiah, the message to Shemaiah, Shemaiah's letter, Jeremiah's letter). The style brief names three levels; the fourth repeats the second level's marks, as the English repeats its double marks.

decisions.choice: यहोयादा; काठ; गले की बेड़ी (L), गले की लोहे की बेड़ी (B), लोहे का पट्टा (R)
decisions.reason: Jehoiada keeps the form of 2 Chronicles 22-24. The stocks are काठ, as 2 Chronicles 16:10 and Acts 16:24 have them in this translation; the collar is named for what it was, as the English does at B and R.

decisions.choice: तुम from Shemaiah to the priest Zephaniah
decisions.reason: Shemaiah writes to Zephaniah as a fellow leader giving orders, and the LORD's message quotes him; Hindi keeps तुम, the form used between equals, as in the rest of the scene.

decisions.choice: Иодай; колода / колодки; ошейник
decisions.reason: Jehoiada keeps the form of Kings and Chronicles. Shemaiah's letter is the third level of quotation, so it takes ‘ ’, as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: pequdim "監督たち" (L), "監督の役人たち" (B), R "責任者" (m2); meshugga' umitnabbe' "狂って預言者のように振る舞う" (L), "預言者を気取る狂った者" (B), "預言者のように振る舞うおかしな者" (R), a sneer (m3); hammahpekhet "足かせ" (JER-3, 20:2), hatstsinoq "首かせ" (L, B), "首に鉄の輪" (R) (m4, uncertain).
decisions.reason: Shemaiah speaks to the priest plainly and with respect forms for God; Jehoiada "ヨヤダ" as 2KI 11.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה לָ֚מָּה לֹ֣א גָעַ֔רְתָּ בְּיִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הָֽעֲנְּתֹתִ֑י הַמִּתְנַבֵּ֖א לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, why not you rebuked Jeremiah the Anathothite, the [one] acting the prophet to you?

en.L: And now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who acts the prophet to you?
en.B: So why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who sets himself up as a prophet among you?
en.R: So why have you not done anything about Jeremiah from Anathoth? He is acting like a prophet among you.

es.L: Ahora, pues, ¿por qué no has reprendido a Jeremías de Anatot, que se hace profeta entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: Entonces, ¿por qué no has reprendido a Jeremías de Anatot, que se hace pasar por profeta entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.R: Entonces, ¿por qué no has hecho nada con Jeremías de Anatot? Está actuando como profeta entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, pourquoi n’as-tu pas réprimandé Jérémie d’Anatoth, qui fait le prophète chez vous ?
fr.B: Pourquoi donc n’as-tu pas réprimandé Jérémie d’Anatoth, qui se pose en prophète parmi vous ?
fr.R: Alors pourquoi n’as-tu rien fait contre Jérémie d’Anatoth ? Il se prend pour un prophète parmi vous.

sw.L: Basi sasa, kwa nini hukumkemea Yeremia wa Anathothi, ajifanyaye nabii kwenu?
sw.B: Basi kwa nini hukumkemea Yeremia wa Anathothi, anayejifanya nabii kati yenu?
sw.R: Basi kwa nini hukumchukulia hatua Yeremia kutoka Anathothi? Anajifanya nabii kati yenu.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, sao ông không quở trách Giê-rê-mi người A-na-tốt, là kẻ tự xưng là tiên tri cho các ông?
vi.B: Vậy sao ông không quở trách Giê-rê-mi người A-na-tốt, là kẻ tự xưng là tiên tri giữa các ông?
vi.R: Vậy sao ông không làm gì đối với Giê-rê-mi người A-na-tốt? Hắn đang làm như mình là tiên tri giữa các ông.

ko.L: 그런데 이제 어찌하여 여러분에게 예언자 노릇을 하는 아나돗 사람 예레미야를 꾸짖지 않으십니까?
ko.B: 그런데 어찌하여 여러분 가운데서 예언자 행세를 하는 아나돗 사람 예레미야를 책망하지 않으십니까?
ko.R: 그런데 어찌하여 아나돗 출신 예레미야를 그냥 두십니까? 그는 여러분 가운데서 예언자인 척하고 있습니다.

pt.L: E agora, por que você não repreendeu Jeremias de Anatote, que se faz de profeta para vocês?
pt.B: Então, por que você não repreendeu Jeremias de Anatote, que se faz de profeta entre vocês?
pt.R: Então, por que você não fez nada contra Jeremias de Anatote? Ele está agindo como profeta entre vocês.

am.L: አሁንም ለእናንተ ራሱን ነቢይ የሚያደርገውን የዓናቶቱን ኤርምያስን ለምን አልገሠጽከውም?
am.B: ታዲያ በመካከላችሁ ራሱን ነቢይ የሚያደርገውን የዓናቶቱን ኤርምያስን ለምን አልገሠጽከውም?
am.R: ታዲያ ከዓናቶት የመጣውን ኤርምያስን ለምን ምንም አላደረግህበትም? እርሱ በመካከላችሁ እንደ ነቢይ ይሠራል።

hi.L: और अब, तुमने अनातोती यिर्मयाह को क्यों नहीं डाँटा, जो तुम्हारे बीच भविष्यद्वक्ता बनता है?
hi.B: तो फिर तुमने अनातोत के यिर्मयाह को क्यों नहीं डाँटा, जो तुम्हारे बीच भविष्यद्वक्ता बन बैठा है?
hi.R: तो फिर तुमने अनातोत के यिर्मयाह के विरुद्ध कुछ क्यों नहीं किया? वह तुम्हारे बीच नबी होने का दिखावा कर रहा है।

ru.L: И теперь, почему ты не обуздал Иеремию из Анафофа, пророчествующего вам?
ru.B: Почему же ты не обуздал Иеремию из Анафофа, который выдаёт себя у вас за пророка?
ru.R: Почему же ты ничего не сделал с Иеремией из Анафофа? Он ведёт себя у вас как пророк.

ja.L: それなのに今、なぜあなたは、あなたがたに対して預言者のように振る舞っているアナトトのエレミヤを、叱責しないのか。
ja.B: それなのに、なぜあなたは、あなたがたの間で預言者を気取っているアナトトのエレミヤを、とがめないのか。
ja.R: それなのに、なぜあなたは、アナトトのエレミヤに何もしないのか。あの男は、あなたがたの間で、預言者のように振る舞っているではないか。

uk.L: А тепер чому ти не докорив Єремії з Анатоту, який пророкує вам?
uk.B: То чому ж ти не присоромив Єремії з Анатоту, який видає себе у вас за пророка?
uk.R: То чому ти нічого не зробив з Єремією з Анатоту? Він поводиться серед вас, як пророк.

decisions.choice: rebuked: reprimanded and restrained
decisions.reason: The verb means to rebuke sharply, and so to check or restrain. Shemaiah wants Zephaniah to use his authority against Jeremiah, as verse 26 says.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah of Anathoth: the prophet named by his home village
decisions.reason: Anathoth was a town of priests a few miles north of Jerusalem, Jeremiah's home (1:1; 11:21-23). Naming him by his village, not as a prophet, may be meant to belittle him.

decisions.choice: who acts the prophet: the same verb form as in verse 26
decisions.reason: Shemaiah uses the word he used for the madman, so he counts Jeremiah among them.

decisions.choice: sets himself up as a prophet (Balanced); acting like a prophet (Readable); among you
decisions.reason: As in verse 26. Balanced and Readable say "among you", since Jeremiah prophesied in Jerusalem, where Zephaniah was.

decisions.choice: ga'arta "叱責しない" (L), "とがめない" (B), "何もしない" (R) (m1); hammitnabbe' "預言者のように振る舞っている" (L, R), "預言者を気取っている" (B), the same wording as verse 26 (m3); "アナトトのエレミヤ" (every level, m2).
decisions.reason: The Hebrew asks with lammah but has no question mark in the English L; Japanese closes with 。 as the English.

source.text: כִּ֣י עַל־כֵּ֞ן שָׁלַ֥ח אֵלֵ֛ינוּ בָּבֶ֥ל לֵאמֹ֖ר אֲרֻכָּ֣ה הִ֑יא בְּנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְשֵׁ֔בוּ וְנִטְע֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְאִכְל֖וּ אֶת־פְּרִיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: For therefore he has sent to us [to] Babylon, saying: Long [is] it; build houses and dwell, and plant gardens and eat their produce.

en.L: For therefore he has sent to us [in] Babylon, saying, 'It [will be] long; build houses and live [in them], and plant gardens and eat their produce.'"'"
en.B: For he has even sent word to us in Babylon, saying, 'It will be a long time. Build houses and settle down in them. Plant gardens and eat what they produce.'"'"
en.R: He has even sent a message to us in Babylon. He told us that we will be here a long time, and that we should build houses and live in them, and plant gardens and eat the food they grow."'"

es.L: Porque por eso nos ha enviado [a decir en] Babilonia: “Va para largo; edifiquen casas y habiten [en ellas], y planten huertos y coman su fruto”’”».
es.B: Porque incluso nos ha mandado decir aquí en Babilonia: “Va a ser largo. Construyan casas y establézcanse en ellas. Planten huertos y coman de lo que producen”’”».
es.R: Incluso nos mandó un mensaje aquí en Babilonia. Nos dijo que vamos a estar aquí mucho tiempo, y que debemos construir casas y vivir en ellas, y plantar huertos y comer lo que crezca en ellos’”».

fr.L: Car c’est pourquoi il nous a envoyé [dire] à Babylone : « [Ce sera] long ; bâtissez des maisons et habitez[-les], plantez des jardins et mangez-en le fruit. »’” »
fr.B: Il nous a même envoyé dire à Babylone : « Ce sera long. Bâtissez des maisons et installez-vous-y. Plantez des jardins et mangez ce qu’ils produisent. »’” »
fr.R: Il nous a même envoyé un message à Babylone. Il nous a dit que nous serions ici pour longtemps, et que nous devions construire des maisons et les habiter, et planter des jardins et manger ce qui y pousse.’” »

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa hiyo ametutumia [ujumbe huku] Babeli, akisema, 'Itakuwa [muda] mrefu; jengeni nyumba mkae [ndani yake], pandeni bustani mle matunda yake.'"'"
sw.B: Kwa maana hata ametutumia ujumbe huku Babeli, akisema, 'Itachukua muda mrefu. Jengeni nyumba mkatulie ndani yake. Pandeni bustani mle mazao yake.'"'"
sw.R: Hata ametutumia ujumbe huku Babeli. Alituambia kwamba tutakaa hapa muda mrefu, na kwamba tujenge nyumba tukaishi ndani yake, na tupande bustani tule chakula kinachoota humo."'"

vi.L: Vì vậy hắn đã gửi đến chúng tôi [ở] Ba-by-lôn mà nói: 'Còn lâu; hãy xây nhà mà ở, hãy trồng vườn và ăn hoa quả của vườn.'"'"
vi.B: Vì hắn còn gửi thư đến chúng tôi ở Ba-by-lôn mà nói: 'Sẽ còn lâu lắm. Hãy xây nhà và định cư ở đó. Hãy trồng vườn và ăn hoa quả vườn sinh ra.'"'"
vi.R: Hắn còn gửi thư đến cho chúng tôi ở Ba-by-lôn. Hắn bảo rằng chúng tôi sẽ còn ở đây lâu, và rằng chúng tôi nên xây nhà mà ở, trồng vườn và ăn rau trái vườn sinh ra."'"

ko.L: 그가 바빌론에 있는 우리에게 [편지를] 보내어 말하기를, '[포로 생활이] 오래갈 것이다. 집을 짓고 [그 안에] 살아라. 밭을 일구고 그 열매를 먹어라.' 하였습니다."'"
ko.B: 그는 바빌론에 있는 우리에게까지 편지를 보내어 이렇게 말했습니다. '포로 생활이 오래갈 것이다. 집을 짓고 그곳에 자리 잡고 살아라. 텃밭을 가꾸고 거기서 나는 것을 먹어라.'"'"
ko.R: 그는 바빌론에 있는 우리에게까지 편지를 보냈습니다. 그는 우리가 여기에 오래 있을 것이니 집을 짓고 살고, 텃밭을 가꾸어 거기서 기른 것을 먹으라고 했습니다."'"

pt.L: Pois por isso ele nos mandou [dizer na] Babilônia: 'Vai [ser] longo; construam casas e habitem [nelas], e plantem pomares e comam o seu fruto.'"'"
pt.B: Pois ele chegou a nos mandar dizer na Babilônia: 'Vai demorar muito. Construam casas e se instalem nelas. Plantem pomares e comam o que eles produzirem.'"'"
pt.R: Ele chegou a mandar uma mensagem para nós na Babilônia. Ele nos disse que vamos ficar aqui muito tempo, e que devemos construir casas e morar nelas, e plantar pomares e comer o que eles produzirem."'"

am.L: ስለዚህ ወደ እኛ ወደ ባቢሎን፦ “[ጊዜው] ረጅም ነው፤ ቤቶችን ሥሩ፤ [በእነርሱም] ተቀመጡ፤ የአትክልት ቦታዎችንም ትከሉ፤ ፍሬያቸውንም ብሉ” ብሎ ልኮብናልና።’”»
am.B: በባቢሎን ወዳለነው ወደ እኛ እንኳ፦ “ጊዜው ረጅም ይሆናል። ቤቶችን ሠርታችሁ በእነርሱ ተቀመጡ። የአትክልት ቦታዎችን ተክላችሁ ፍሬያቸውን ብሉ” ብሎ ልኮብናልና።’”»
am.R: በባቢሎን ወዳለነው ወደ እኛ እንኳ መልእክት ልኳል። እዚህ ብዙ ጊዜ እንደምንቆይ፣ ቤቶችን ሠርተን እንድንኖርባቸው፣ የአትክልት ቦታዎችንም ተክለን የሚያፈሩትን ምግብ እንድንበላ ነግሮናል።’”»

hi.L: क्योंकि इसी कारण उसने बाबुल में हमारे पास कहला भेजा है, 'वह [समय] लंबा [होगा]; घर बनाओ और [उनमें] बसो, और बारियाँ लगाओ और उनकी उपज खाओ।'"'"
hi.B: क्योंकि उसने तो बाबुल में हमारे पास यह कहला भेजा है, 'अभी बहुत समय लगेगा। घर बनाओ और उनमें बस जाओ। बारियाँ लगाओ और उनकी उपज खाओ।'"'"
hi.R: उसने तो बाबुल में हमारे पास भी संदेश भेजा है। उसने हमसे कहा कि हम यहाँ बहुत समय तक रहेंगे, और हमें घर बनाकर उनमें रहना चाहिए, और बग़ीचे लगाकर उनमें उगनेवाला भोजन खाना चाहिए।"'"

ru.L: Ведь он для того и послал к нам [в] Вавилон, говоря: «Это надолго; стройте дома и живите [в них], и сажайте сады и ешьте их плоды.»’”»
ru.B: Ведь он даже прислал нам в Вавилон весть: «Это будет долго. Стройте дома и обживайтесь в них. Сажайте сады и ешьте их плоды.»’”»
ru.R: Он даже прислал весть нам в Вавилон. Он сказал, что мы будем здесь долго и что нам надо строить дома и жить в них, сажать сады и есть то, что на них вырастет.’”»

ja.L: まことに、彼はバビロンにいるわたしたちのもとに[手紙を]送って、こう言ったのだ。『[捕囚は]長い。家々を建てて住め。園を造ってその実を食べよ』と。」』」
ja.B: 彼は、バビロンにいるわたしたちのところにまで、こう書いて送ってきたのだ。『捕囚は長く続く。家を建てて、そこに住みなさい。菜園を造って、その実りを食べなさい』と。」』」
ja.R: あの男は、バビロンにいるわたしたちにまで手紙を送ってきた。わたしたちはここに長くいることになるから、家を建てて住み、畑を作って、そこでとれたものを食べるように、と言ってきたのだ。」』」

uk.L: Бо ж він послав до нас [у] Вавилон, кажучи: “Довго [буде]; будуйте доми і живіть [у них], і садіть сади і їжте їхній плід”’”».
uk.B: Бо він навіть послав до нас у Вавилон звістку: “Це буде довго. Будуйте доми й оселяйтеся в них. Садіть сади і їжте те, що вони родять”’”».
uk.R: Він навіть послав нам послання у Вавилон. Він сказав, що ми пробудемо тут довго і що ми маємо будувати доми й жити в них, садити сади і їсти те, що в них виросте’”».

decisions.choice: for therefore: "for he has even" or "for this reason"
alternatives: for that is why he sent to us
decisions.reason: The words are literally "for therefore". They may stress how far Jeremiah has gone ("he has even sent to us"), or say that because no one stopped him he has been able to send his letter. The point is the same: Shemaiah treats the letter as proof that Jeremiah must be silenced.

decisions.choice: it will be long; build houses ...: Shemaiah quotes Jeremiah's letter
decisions.reason: Shemaiah quotes verse 5 and sums up verse 10 as "it will be long". The word for long is feminine, and its subject is not named; the exile, or the time of waiting, is meant.

decisions.choice: the end of Shemaiah's letter and of the LORD's broken-off speech
decisions.reason: The quotation of Shemaiah's letter ends here. The message the LORD began in verse 25 is not finished; verse 29 goes back to the story, and verses 31-32 give the judgment.

decisions.choice: indirect speech
decisions.reason: Readable reports Jeremiah's words in Shemaiah's letter without a further set of quotation marks, which would be hard to follow. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: closing quotation marks
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced close Jeremiah's words, Shemaiah's letter, the LORD's message and the LORD's words to Jeremiah, in that order; Readable has one set fewer (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: edifiquen, habiten, planten, coman (no plural_you span)
decisions.reason: Here Shemaiah quotes Jeremiah's letter to the exiles inside his own complaint; the plural forms are a quotation of a quotation and are left without a reader setting, since the "you" is not the reader's.

decisions.choice: Shemaiah quotes Jeremiah's letter in the words of verse 5
decisions.reason: The quoted words are worded exactly as in verse 5 at Literal and Balanced, so the reader sees that Shemaiah is quoting Jeremiah's letter.

decisions.choice: The quotation marks close in the English order: Jeremiah's words, Shemaiah's letter, the LORD's message
decisions.reason: As the English: Shemaiah quotes Jeremiah's letter (meaning decision m2) inside his own letter, which stands inside the LORD's message for him; the LORD's speech to Jeremiah breaks off here (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's words of verse 5 repeated as verse 5 has them
decisions.reason: Shemaiah quotes the letter, so Literal and Balanced keep the wording of verse 5.

decisions.choice: « » for Jeremiah's words inside Shemaiah's letter
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's words are the fourth level of quotation (inside Shemaiah's letter, inside the LORD's message, inside the LORD's words to Jeremiah); Russian has three kinds of marks, so the fourth level takes « » again.

decisions.choice: Shemaiah quotes Jeremiah's letter (m2): the words of 29:5 repeated as they stand there, at L and B in 『』 inside his own letter's 「」; R reports them as indirect speech, as the English R; 'arukkah hi' "[捕囚は]長い" (L), "捕囚は長く続く" (B), "長くいることになる" (R).
decisions.reason: Closing brackets as the English (L, B four; R three); ki 'al ken "まことに" (L), "……にまで" (B, R) for the English "even" (m1, uncertain).

decisions.choice: the story resumes
decisions.reason: The narrator tells what happened when Shemaiah's letter reached Jerusalem. The LORD's word about Shemaiah in verses 24-28 and 30-32 was given to Jeremiah after this.

decisions.choice: Zephaniah read the letter to Jeremiah
decisions.reason: Instead of putting Jeremiah in the stocks as Shemaiah demanded, Zephaniah read him the letter. The text does not say why: he may have been warning Jeremiah, or giving him a chance to answer. Zephaniah was the priest Zedekiah sent to Jeremiah to ask for his prayers (21:1; 37:3).

decisions.choice: in the ears of: aloud to
decisions.reason: To read "in someone's ears" is to read aloud so that he hears (36:6, 10).

decisions.choice: aloud to (Balanced); out loud to (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m3).

decisions.choice: be'oznei "耳に読み聞かせた" (L), "読んで聞かせた" (B), "声に出して読んで聞かせました" (R) (m3); the story resumes in narrative register (m1).
decisions.reason: Narrative register: R です・ます.

records.literal_gloss: Send to all the exile, saying: Thus says Yahweh concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because that has prophesied to you Shemaiah, and I not sent him, and he made trust you on falsehood,

en.L: "Send to all the exiles, saying, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I did not send him, and he has made you trust in a lie,
en.B: "Send this message to all the exiles: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, although I did not send him, and has led you to trust in a lie,
en.R: "Send this message to all the captives: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Shemaiah has prophesied to you, but I did not send him. He has made you trust in a lie.

es.L: «Envía a decir a todos los del destierro: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de Semaías el nehelamita: Por cuanto Semaías {{plural_you:les|os}} ha profetizado, sin que yo lo enviara, y {{plural_you:les|os}} ha hecho confiar en mentira,
es.B: «Envía este mensaje a todos los desterrados: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca de Semaías el nehelamita: Porque Semaías {{plural_you:les|os}} ha profetizado, aunque yo no lo envié, y {{plural_you:los|os}} ha llevado a confiar en una mentira,
es.R: «Envía este mensaje a todos los prisioneros: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de Semaías el nehelamita: Semaías {{plural_you:les|os}} ha profetizado, pero yo no lo envié. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} ha hecho confiar en una mentira.

fr.L: « Envoie dire à tous les exilés : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de Shemaya le Néhélamite : Parce que Shemaya vous a prophétisé, alors que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je ne l’ai pas envoyé, et qu’il vous a fait vous confier dans le mensonge,
fr.B: « Envoie ce message à tous les exilés : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet de Shemaya le Néhélamite : Parce que Shemaya vous a prophétisé, alors que je ne l’ai pas envoyé, et qu’il vous a amenés à vous confier dans le mensonge,
fr.R: « Envoie ce message à tous les prisonniers : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de Shemaya le Néhélamite : Shemaya vous a prophétisé, mais je ne l’ai pas envoyé. Il vous a fait croire un mensonge, et vous vous y êtes fiés.

sw.L: "Tuma kwa mateka wote, ukisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kuhusu Shemaya Mnehelami: Kwa sababu Shemaya amewatabiria, nami sikumtuma, naye amewafanya kuutumainia uongo,
sw.B: "Watumie mateka wote ujumbe huu: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu Shemaya Mnehelami: Kwa sababu Shemaya amewatabiria ingawa sikumtuma, naye amewafanya kuutumainia uongo,
sw.R: "Watumie watu wote waliochukuliwa mateka ujumbe huu: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu Shemaya Mnehelami: Shemaya amewatabiria, lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} sikumtuma. Amewafanya kuutumainia uongo.

vi.L: "Hãy gửi đến mọi người lưu đày rằng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về Sê-ma-gia người Nê-hê-lam: Vì Sê-ma-gia đã nói tiên tri cho các ngươi, dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không sai nó, và nó đã làm cho các ngươi tin cậy vào sự giả dối,
vi.B: "Con hãy gửi sứ điệp này cho mọi người lưu đày: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về Sê-ma-gia người Nê-hê-lam: Vì Sê-ma-gia đã nói tiên tri cho các ngươi, dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không hề sai nó, và nó đã khiến các ngươi tin cậy vào lời dối trá,
vi.R: "Con hãy gửi sứ điệp này cho mọi người bị bắt làm tù binh: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về Sê-ma-gia người Nê-hê-lam: Sê-ma-gia đã nói tiên tri cho các ngươi, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không sai nó. Nó đã làm cho các ngươi tin cậy vào lời dối trá.

ko.L: "모든 포로에게 [사람을] 보내어 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 느헬람 사람 스마야에 대하여 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 스마야를 보내지 않았는데도 그가 너희에게 예언하여 너희가 거짓을 믿게 했으므로,
ko.B: "모든 포로에게 이 말을 전하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 느헬람 사람 스마야에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 스마야를 보내지 않았는데도 그는 너희에게 예언하여 너희가 거짓을 믿게 만들었다.
ko.R: "포로로 끌려간 모든 사람에게 이 말을 전하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 느헬람 사람 스마야에 대하여 하시는 말씀이다. 스마야는 너희에게 예언했다. 그러나 나는 그를 보내지 않았다. 그는 너희가 거짓말을 믿게 만들었다.

pt.L: "Envia [mensagem] a todos os exilados, dizendo: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} a respeito de Semaías, o neelamita: Porque Semaías lhes profetizou, e eu não o enviei, e ele os fez confiar numa mentira,
pt.B: "Envia esta mensagem a todos os exilados: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} a respeito de Semaías, o neelamita: Porque Semaías profetizou a vocês, embora eu não o tenha enviado, e os levou a confiar numa mentira,
pt.R: "Envia esta mensagem a todos os prisioneiros: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz a respeito de Semaías, o neelamita: Semaías profetizou a vocês, mas eu não o enviei. Ele fez vocês confiarem numa mentira.

am.L: «ወደ ምርኮኞቹ ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለህ ላክ፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለ ኔሔላማዊው ስለ ሸማያ እንዲህ ይላል፦ እኔ ሳልልከው ሸማያ ትንቢት ስለ ተናገረላችሁ፣ በሐሰትም እንድትታመኑ ስላደረጋችሁ፣
am.B: «ወደ ምርኮኞቹ ሁሉ ይህን መልእክት ላክ፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለ ኔሔላማዊው ስለ ሸማያ እንዲህ ይላል፦ እኔ ሳልልከው ሸማያ ትንቢት ስለ ተናገረላችሁና በሐሰት እንድትታመኑ ስላደረጋችሁ፣
am.R: «ወደ ምርኮኞቹ ሁሉ ይህን መልእክት ላክ፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለ ኔሔላማዊው ስለ ሸማያ እንዲህ ይላል፦ ሸማያ ትንቢት ተናግሮላችኋል፤ እኔ ግን አልላክኩትም። ውሸትን እንድታምኑ አድርጓችኋል።

hi.L: "सब बंधुओं के पास यह कहला भेजो, '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} नेहेलामी शमायाह के विषय में यों कहते हैं: इसलिए कि शमायाह ने तुमसे भविष्यवाणी की है, और मैंने उसे नहीं भेजा, और उसने तुम्हें झूठ पर भरोसा करवाया है,
hi.B: "सब बंधुओं के पास यह संदेश भेजो: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} नेहेलामी शमायाह के विषय में यह कहते हैं: क्योंकि शमायाह ने तुमसे भविष्यवाणी की है, यद्यपि मैंने उसे नहीं भेजा, और उसने तुम्हें झूठ पर भरोसा करवाया है,
hi.R: "सब बंदियों के पास यह संदेश भेजो: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} नेहेलामी शमायाह के बारे में यह कहते हैं: शमायाह ने तुमसे भविष्यवाणी की है, पर मैंने उसे नहीं भेजा। उसने तुमसे एक झूठ पर भरोसा करवाया है।

ru.L: «Пошли ко всем изгнанникам, говоря: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о Шемаии нехеламитянине: За то, что Шемаия пророчествовал вам, а {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не посылал его, и он внушил вам надеяться на ложь,
ru.B: «Пошли всем изгнанникам такую весть: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о Шемаии нехеламитянине: Шемаия пророчествовал вам, хотя {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не посылал его, и заставил вас надеяться на ложь,
ru.R: «Пошли всем пленникам такую весть: “Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о Шемаии нехеламитянине: Шемаия пророчествовал вам, но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не посылал его. Он заставил вас надеяться на ложь.

ja.L: 「すべての捕囚の民に[言葉を]送って、言いなさい。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ネヘラム人シェマヤについて、こう言われる。シェマヤはあなたがたに預言したが、わたしは彼を遣わしていない。彼はあなたがたを偽りに頼らせた。それゆえ、
ja.B: 「すべての捕囚の民に、この言葉を書き送りなさい。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ネヘラム人シェマヤについて、こう言われる。わたしは彼を遣わしていないのに、シェマヤはあなたがたに預言し、あなたがたに偽りを信頼させた。それゆえ、
ja.R: 「捕虜となったすべての人々に、このお告げを書き送りなさい。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ネヘラム人シェマヤについて、こう言われる。シェマヤは、あなたたちに預言した。しかし、わたしは彼を遣わしていない。彼は、あなたたちにうそを信じさせ、それに頼らせた。

uk.L: «Пошли до всіх вигнанців, кажучи: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про Шемаю нехеламітянина: За те, що Шемая пророкував вам, а {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не посилав його, і він змусив вас надіятися на неправду,
uk.B: «Пошли таке послання всім вигнанцям: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про Шемаю нехеламітянина: Через те, що Шемая пророкував вам, хоч {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не посилав його, і змусив вас покладатися на неправду,
uk.R: «Пошли таке послання всім полоненим: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про Шемаю нехеламітянина: Шемая пророкував вам, але {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не посилав його. Він змусив вас покладатися на брехню.

decisions.choice: because ...: the charge, now spoken in full
decisions.reason: This takes up the unfinished "because" of verse 25 and goes on to the "therefore" of verse 32.

decisions.choice: I did not send him, and he has made you trust in a lie
decisions.reason: The same words were spoken to Hananiah, who broke the yoke from Jeremiah's neck: "the LORD has not sent you, and you have made this people trust in a lie" (28:15). Shemaiah, like Hananiah, is a prophet God did not send.

decisions.choice: has prophesied to you: in his letter
decisions.reason: Shemaiah's letter claimed to speak for God ("the LORD has made you priest", verse 26). This counts as prophesying, though God had not sent him.

decisions.choice: God's words to Jeremiah in double marks, the message to the exiles in single marks
decisions.reason: The message Jeremiah is to send is quoted inside God's words to him, as in 7:2. Readable ends the sentence here and starts verse 32 with "So".

decisions.choice: ya'an 'asher ... laken (verses 31-32) "……ので" → "それゆえ、" (L, B): Japanese gives the charge as full sentences and carries "それゆえ、" at the end of verse 31 so that the sentence runs into verse 32 as the Hebrew; R ends verse 31 and starts verse 32 with "だから".
decisions.reason: God's words to Jeremiah 「, the message 『 (JER convention); vayyavtach 'etkhem 'al sheqer as 28:15 (偽りを信頼させた / うそを信じさせ、それに頼らせた).

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י פֹקֵ֜ד עַל־שְׁמַעְיָ֣ה הַנֶּחֱלָמִי֮ וְעַל־זַרְעוֹ֒ לֹא־יִהְיֶ֨ה ל֜וֹ אִ֣ישׁ׀יוֹשֵׁ֣ב׀בְּתוֹךְ־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה וְלֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֥ה בַטּ֛וֹב אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶֽׂה־לְעַמִּ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־סָרָ֥ה דִבֶּ֖ר עַל־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: therefore thus says Yahweh: Behold, I [am] visiting upon Shemaiah the Nehelamite and upon his offspring; not will be to him a man dwelling in [the] midst of the people the this, and not he will see the good that I [am] doing for my people, declaration of Yahweh, for rebellion he has spoken against Yahweh.

en.L: therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Look, I am visiting [punishment] on Shemaiah the Nehelamite and on his offspring. He will not have anyone living among this people, and he will not see the good that I am doing for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for he has spoken rebellion against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'"
en.B: therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: I am about to punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. No one of his line will be left living among this people, and he will not see the good that I am going to do for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because he has preached rebellion against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'"
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. None of his family will be left among this people. He will not live to see the good things I am going to do for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. This is because he has told people to turn against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'"

es.L: por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: He aquí, yo castigaré a Semaías el nehelamita y a su descendencia. No tendrá quien habite en medio de este pueblo, ni verá el bien que yo haré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque ha hablado rebelión contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}”».
es.B: por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Voy a castigar a Semaías el nehelamita y a sus descendientes. No le quedará nadie de su linaje que viva en medio de este pueblo, y él no verá el bien que voy a hacer a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque ha incitado a la rebelión contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}”».
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Castigaré a Semaías el nehelamita y a sus descendientes. No quedará nadie de su familia entre este pueblo. Él no vivirá para ver las cosas buenas que voy a hacer por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Esto es porque le ha dicho a la gente que se rebele contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}”».

fr.L: c’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Voici, je vais punir Shemaya le Néhélamite et sa descendance. Il n’aura personne qui habite au milieu de ce peuple, et il ne verra pas le bien que je vais faire à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car il a prêché la révolte contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.” »
fr.B: c’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je vais punir Shemaya le Néhélamite et sa descendance. Personne de sa lignée ne vivra plus au milieu de ce peuple, et il ne verra pas le bien que je vais faire à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’il a appelé à la révolte contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.” »
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je vais punir Shemaya le Néhélamite et ses descendants. Personne de sa famille ne restera au milieu de ce peuple. Il ne vivra pas assez longtemps pour voir le bien que je vais faire à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Car il a poussé les gens à se révolter contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.” »

sw.L: kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, nitamwadhibu Shemaya Mnehelami na uzao wake. Hatakuwa na mtu wa kukaa kati ya watu hawa, wala hataona mema nitakayowatendea watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana amenena maasi juu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.'"
sw.B: kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ninakaribia kumwadhibu Shemaya Mnehelami na wazao wake. Hakuna hata mmoja wa ukoo wake atakayebaki akiishi kati ya watu hawa, wala yeye hataona mema nitakayowatendea watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu amehubiri uasi dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.'"
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitamwadhibu Shemaya Mnehelami na wazao wake. Hakuna hata mmoja wa jamaa yake atakayebaki kati ya watu hawa. Hataishi kuona mambo mema nitakayowatendea watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hii ni kwa sababu amewaambia watu wamwasi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.'"

vi.L: vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phạt Sê-ma-gia người Nê-hê-lam và dòng dõi nó. Nó sẽ không có ai sống giữa dân này, và nó sẽ không thấy điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho dân Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, vì nó đã nói lời phản nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.'"
vi.B: nên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ta sắp phạt Sê-ma-gia người Nê-hê-lam và dòng dõi nó. Sẽ không còn ai thuộc dòng dõi nó sống giữa dân này, và nó sẽ không thấy điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp làm cho dân Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, vì nó đã xúi giục phản nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.'"
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta sẽ phạt Sê-ma-gia người Nê-hê-lam và con cháu nó. Không ai trong gia đình nó còn sống giữa dân này. Nó sẽ không sống để thấy những điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp làm cho dân Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Đó là vì nó đã xúi dân chúng chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.'"

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보아라, 내가 느헬람 사람 스마야와 그의 자손을 벌하겠다. 그에게는 이 백성 가운데 살아남을 사람이 하나도 없을 것이고, 그는 내가 내 백성에게 베풀 복을 보지 못할 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 반역하는 말을 했기 때문이다.'"
ko.B: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 느헬람 사람 스마야와 그의 자손을 벌하겠다. 그의 집안에서는 이 백성 가운데 살아남을 사람이 하나도 없을 것이다. 그는 내가 내 백성에게 베풀 복을 보지 못할 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 반역하도록 부추겼기 때문이다.'"
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내가 느헬람 사람 스마야와 그의 자손을 벌하겠다. 그의 집안 사람은 이 백성 가운데 하나도 남지 않을 것이다. 그는 내가 내 백성에게 해 줄 좋은 일들을 살아서 보지 못할 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그가 사람들에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 등을 돌리라고 했기 때문이다.'"

pt.L: portanto, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Eis que eu farei Semaías, o neelamita, e a sua descendência prestarem contas. Ele não terá ninguém que habite no meio deste povo, e não verá o bem que estou fazendo ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, pois falou rebelião contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.'"
pt.B: por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Castigarei Semaías, o neelamita, e os seus descendentes. Ninguém da sua família ficará vivendo no meio deste povo, e ele não verá o bem que vou fazer ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque incitou à rebelião contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.'"
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Vou castigar Semaías, o neelamita, e os seus descendentes. Ninguém da família dele vai ficar no meio deste povo. Ele não vai viver para ver as coisas boas que vou fazer pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Isso porque ele disse ao povo que se voltasse contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.'"

am.L: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ፣ ኔሔላማዊውን ሸማያንና ዘሩን እቀጣለሁ፤ በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል የሚቀመጥ ሰው አይኖረውም፤ ለሕዝቤም የማደርገውን መልካም ነገር አያይም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ላይ ዓመፅን ተናግሯልና።”»
am.B: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ኔሔላማዊውን ሸማያንና ዘሮቹን ልቀጣ ነው። ከዘሩ በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል የሚኖር አንድም አይቀርም፤ ለሕዝቤም የማደርገውን መልካም ነገር አያይም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ላይ ዓመፅን አውጇልና።”»
am.R: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ኔሔላማዊውን ሸማያንና ዘሮቹን እቀጣለሁ። ከቤተሰቡ በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል የሚቀር አይኖርም። ለሕዝቤ የማደርገውን መልካም ነገር ለማየት በሕይወት አይኖርም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ይህም ሰዎች {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እንዲክዱ ስለ ነገራቸው ነው።”»

hi.L: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: देखो, मैं नेहेलामी शमायाह को और उसके वंश को [दंड] दूँगा। इन लोगों के बीच उसका कोई न रहेगा जो बसा रहे, और वह उस भलाई को न देखेगा जो मैं अपनी प्रजा के लिए करने पर हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, क्योंकि उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के विरुद्ध विद्रोह की बातें कही हैं।'"
hi.B: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: मैं नेहेलामी शमायाह और उसके वंश को दंड देने पर हूँ। इन लोगों के बीच उसके वंश का कोई जीवित न बचेगा, और वह उस भलाई को न देखेगा जो मैं अपनी प्रजा के लिए करनेवाला हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, क्योंकि उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के विरुद्ध विद्रोह करने को उकसाया है।'"
hi.R: इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: मैं नेहेलामी शमायाह को और उसके वंशजों को दंड दूँगा। इन लोगों के बीच उसके परिवार का कोई नहीं बचेगा। वह उन अच्छी बातों को देखने के लिए जीवित नहीं रहेगा जो मैं अपने लोगों के लिए करने जा रहा हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। यह इसलिए है क्योंकि उसने लोगों से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के विरुद्ध हो जाने को कहा है।'"

ru.L: поэтому так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} накажу Шемаию нехеламитянина и его потомство. Не будет у него никого, живущего среди этого народа, и он не увидит добра, которое {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} делаю для {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — потому что он говорил отступничество против {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.”»
ru.B: поэтому так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Я накажу Шемаию нехеламитянина и его потомков. Никого из его рода не останется среди этого народа, и он не увидит добра, которое {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделаю для {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, потому что он призывал к мятежу против {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.”»
ru.R: Поэтому вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Я накажу Шемаию нехеламитянина и его потомков. Никого из его семьи не останется среди этого народа. Он не доживёт до того, чтобы увидеть добро, которое {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделаю для {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Это потому, что он призывал людей восстать против {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.”»

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。見なさい、わたしはネヘラム人シェマヤとその子孫を罰する。彼には、この民の中に住む者が一人もいなくなり、わたしがわたしの民に行おうとしている幸いを、彼は見ることがない――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。彼が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に対する反逆を語ったからだ。』」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは今、ネヘラム人シェマヤとその子孫を罰しようとしている。この民の中に、彼の家系の者は一人も残らない。わたしがわたしの民に行おうとしている幸いを、彼は見ることがない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。彼が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に逆らうようにと語ったからだ。』」
ja.R: だから、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは、ネヘラム人シェマヤとその子孫を罰する。この民の中に、彼の家族は一人も残らない。わたしがわたしの民のために行おうとしている良いことを、彼は生きて見ることがない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。彼は、人々に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に逆らうようにと語ったからだ。』」

uk.L: тому так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покараю Шемаю нехеламітянина і його потомство. Не буде в нього нікого, хто жив би серед цього народу, і він не побачить добра, яке {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} роблю для {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, бо він говорив про відступ від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}”».
uk.B: тому так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Я ось-ось покараю Шемаю нехеламітянина і його нащадків. Ніхто з його роду не залишиться жити серед цього народу, і він не побачить добра, яке {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зроблю для {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, бо він підбурював до бунту проти {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}”».

Він не доживе до того добра, яке {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зроблю для {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Це тому, що він намовляв людей повстати проти {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}”».

decisions.choice: I am visiting on: I will punish
decisions.reason: The verb that in verse 10 meant God's coming to help means here, with "on", his coming to punish.

decisions.choice: he will not have anyone dwelling among this people: his family line will be cut off
decisions.reason: No descendant of his will be among God's people when they are restored. He promised a quick return and will have no share in the real one.

decisions.choice: the good that I am doing for my people: the restoration promised in verses 10-14
decisions.reason: The "good" is the "good word" of verse 10: the return from exile. The participle describes God's plan as already under way.

decisions.choice: he has spoken rebellion against the LORD: the charge against a false prophet
decisions.reason: The law says that a prophet who speaks rebellion against the LORD is to die (Deuteronomy 13:6), and Jeremiah used these words of Hananiah (28:16).

decisions.choice: punish (Balanced, Readable); preached rebellion (Balanced); told people to turn against (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "visiting" and brackets the punishment it implies; Balanced and Readable say "punish". "Spoken rebellion" means urging people to turn from the LORD.

decisions.choice: closing quotation marks
decisions.reason: The message to the exiles and the LORD's words to Jeremiah both end here.

decisions.choice: "nói lời phản nghịch" (L); "xúi giục phản nghịch" (B); "xúi dân chúng chống lại" (R)
decisions.reason: The same charge as against Hananiah (28:16), worded the same way at each level.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 반역하는", with the plain particle
decisions.reason: The words stand in God's own message, so God speaks of himself without the honorific particle "께", as in 28:16.

decisions.choice: विद्रोह की बातें कहना (L); विद्रोह करने को उकसाना (B); लोगों से ... के विरुद्ध हो जाने को कहना (R)
decisions.reason: "He has spoken rebellion against the LORD" keeps the wording given to the same charge against Hananiah at 28:16, at each level.

decisions.choice: говорил отступничество (L); призывал к мятежу (B); призывал восстать (R)
decisions.reason: "Spoken rebellion against the LORD" keeps the wording of 28:16 at each level, since both verses echo Deuteronomy 13.

decisions.choice: poqed 'al "罰する" (every level, m1), unlike the visit for good in 29:10; lo' yihyeh lo 'ish yoshev "住む者が一人もいなくなり" (L), "彼の家系の者は一人も残らない" (B), "家族は一人も残らない" (R) (m2); battov "幸い" (L, B), "良いこと" (R) (m3); sarah dibber 'al YHWH as 28:16 (m4).
decisions.reason: paqad 'al 罰する as AMO / HOS; sarah as JER 28:16.
